### **CUET - At a Glance**

Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) is one of the leading Public University of Bangladesh. It is situated alongside the Chittagong Capital road 25km away from the city of Chittagong, the main sea port and the second largest city of Bangladesh. The University is taking shape in about 171 acres land of magnificent natural settings comprising pristine hills, plane lands and takes with numerous specks of plants. It is playing a pioneering role for higher education, research and development in the field of engineering and applied sciences since its inception as engineering college, Chittagong in year 1986. Its graduates are among the leaders in their respective fields.

#### **CUET Overview**

A Beacon of Engineering Excellence in Bangladesh. Established in 1968 as the Engineering College, Chittagong, later evolving into BIT Chittagong and eventually attaining university status in 2003, CUET stands tall as a pioneer in engineering education. Nestled amidst the scenic landscapes near Chittagong, it blends academic prowess with practical learning, fostering a culture of innovation and holistic development. With a rich heritage and a commitment to cutting-edge research, CUET continues to shape future engineers and contribute significantly to the nation's technological advancement

text:
## **History of CUET **

Former Bangladesh Institute of Technology, Chittagong, abbreviated as BIT Chittagong is presently Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET). It is one of the prominent and prestigious autonomous self-degree-awarding institute in the engineering education of Bangladesh. This Institute was created out of Engineering College, Chittagong that was established in 1968. The Chittagong Engineering College functioned as the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Chittagong. Through a Government ordinance in 1986, the college was converted into an Institute of Technology. In 2003 this institute of technology was converted into a public university. The honorable President of Bangladesh is the Chancellor of the University.

Chittagong University Of Engineering & Technology abbreviated as CUET, is one of the prominent and prestigious degree awarding institute in the engineering education of Bangladesh. This University was created out of Engineering College, Chittagong, that was established in 1968. The Engineering College , Chittagong , functioned as the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Chittagong. Though a Government Ordinance in 1986 the college was converted into an institution (BIT, Chittagong).The honorable President of Bangladesh is the visitor of the institute . A Board of Governors headed by a Chairman appointed by the President is the policy making and administrative authority. There were three other similar Institutes of Technology in the country namely BIT Khulna, BIT Rajshahi and BIT Dhaka that are converted to Khulna University Of Engineering, Rajshashi University Of Engineering & Technology(RUET) & Technology(KUET),Dhaka University Of Engineering & Technology(DUET)

CUET is unique and incompatible due to its proximity to Chittagong, the major sea-port and the beautiful Hill city of the country. The University is situated by the side of the Chittagong-Kaptai road some 25 kilometers off from the center of Chittagong City. Moreover all the tourist attractions of the country like the large hydroelectric plant, the natural beauty of the lake of Kaptai, hill sports of Rangamati, Bandarban, the longest sea beach of the world and tourist resort of Cox's Bazar are only a few hours journey.

### **Vision**

- To become a prominent and prestigious world-class University in Engineering. & Technology offering state-of- the- art education and research for socio-economic development

### **Mission**

- To create and impart knowledge to develop highly qualified and committed professionals through teaching-learning and research in order to play a leading role in the innovation of engineering and technology for sustainable development of Bangladesh and global economy

### **Objectives**

- To provide outcome based education for students in engineering and technology to become potential members of the society for building national capabilities and socio-economic development.
- To undertake collaborative research to create opportunities for long-term interaction with academia and industries as well as outreach services to the society.
- To promote good governance and strong leadership in all levels of the University administration.
-  To establish a campus life conducive to the exchange of knowledge, views, and innovative ideas among the students, faculty, staff and visiting scholars

### **Campus life**

Campus Life at CUET is more than just an academic journey; it's a vibrant mosaic of experiences, interactions, and personal growth. From rigorous academic pursuits to extracurricular engagements, the campus thrives with diversity and opportunities for students to flourish. With a rich blend of cultural exchange, innovative initiatives, and a supportive community, CUET's campus life nurtures not only academic excellence but also the development of well-rounded individuals equipped to thrive in a dynamic world. Every step within our campus resonates with camaraderie, exploration, and the forging of lifelong connections.

#### **Establish some rules at the beginning**

Establishing clear rules and guidelines at the onset is fundamental to creating a structured and productive environment. By laying down these foundational principles, whether in an educational setting, a workplace, or any community, you pave the way for consistency, mutual understanding, and effective communication. These rules serve as pillars, ensuring fairness, fostering respect, and guiding individuals toward shared goals. Embracing these established guidelines from the beginning sets a tone of accountability, encourages cooperation, and ultimately contributes to a harmonious and thriving environment.

#### **Challenges**

Challenges, though daunting, are inherent stepping stones toward personal and collective growth. Embracing these hurdles fosters resilience, innovation, and the opportunity to refine our skills and mindset. At CUET, challenges aren't setbacks but catalysts for development. They propel us to seek innovative solutions, foster collaboration, and inspire us to surpass our limits. By confronting challenges head-on, we cultivate a culture of adaptability and perseverance, turning obstacles into pathways for continuous improvement and success.

#### **Our goals**

Stepping Stones to Achievement and Fulfillment. Setting and striving for goals is the cornerstone of progress and success. At CUET, we understand the pivotal role that clear objectives play in guiding our paths and shaping our futures. These goals act as beacons, directing our efforts, inspiring us to push beyond limitations, and fueling our determination to attain excellence in every endeavor. Embracing a culture of purposeful goal-setting empowers us to envision, plan, and execute with precision, fostering a community of driven individuals dedicated to turning aspirations into reality.

Goals serve as the compass that navigates us through the journey of growth and accomplishment. At CUET, setting ambitious yet achievable goals is ingrained in our ethos, propelling us towards continual advancement and excellence. They aren't just markers of success but also catalysts for innovation, instilling a sense of direction and purpose. By fostering a culture that values and pursues goals, we foster determination, resilience, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, empowering individuals to transform aspirations into tangible achievements and contribute meaningfully to society.

#### **Navigating Through Objectives and Missions**

Fulfilling Commitments, Driving Progress. At CUET, every task is a commitment to excellence and advancement. Mission-driven approach empowers us to tackle challenges, innovate, and deliver impactful results. From academic pursuits to research endeavors, each task undertaken embodies our dedication to fostering growth, contributing to societal progress, and nurturing a culture of achievement. We strive to fulfill our responsibilities with diligence, resilience, and an unwavering focus on achieving our collective vision for a brighter future.

## Undergraduate Study

Discover advanced Undergraduate programs and research opportunities at CUET designed to propel your academic and professional journey forward.

## Elevate Your Career - Apply for Undergraduate Studies at CUET

[Apply Here](https://admissionckruet.ac.bd/)

### Undergraduate Study Details

The university received a significant number of Undergraduate students (B.Sc) at various degree awarding departments every year. The details of admission for the Undergraduate program are described below:

#### Student Admission, Equivalence and Admission on Transfer:

- The four academic years of study for the degree of B. Sc. Engineering and BURP shall be designated as Level-1 class, Level-2 class, Level-3 class and Level-4 class in succeeding higher Levels of study. The five academic years of study for the degree of B. Arch shall be designated as Level-1 class, Level-2 class, Level-3 class, Level-4, and Level-5 class in succeeding higher Levels of study. Students shall be admitted into the Level-1 class.
- An Admission Committee shall be formed in each academic session by the Academic Council for admission into Level-1 B. Sc. Engineering, BURP and B. Arch class, vide Article 42 of the University Act.
- According to Article 42(2) of this University Act, candidates for admission into the Level-1 class must have passed the H.S.C. Examination from a Higher Secondary Education Board in Bangladesh (after 12 years of schooling) with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics as his/her subjects of Examination or any examination in Higher Secondary Level of examination recognised as Equivalent thereto, and must also fulfill all other requirements as may be prescribed by the Admission Committee.
- As specified in Article 42(1) of this University Act, the rules and conditions for admission into various courses of studies of Departments shall be framed by the Academic Council on the recommendation of the Admission Committee.
- All candidates for admission into the courses of B. Sc. Engineering, BURP and B. Arch. must be the citizens of Bangladesh unless the candidate is against the seats which are reserved for foreign students. Candidates for all seats, except the reserved ones, if any, shall be selected on the basis of merit. The rules for admission into the reserved seats (for foreign students & tribal), if any, shall be framed by the Academic Council on the recommendation of the Admission Committee.
- No candidate shall be admitted in the Level-1 class after the beginning of the corresponding session, i.e., when the classes start.
- List of newly admitted students shall be notified in the University notice Board as well as in the University Website before commencement of the classes.
- If any newly admitted student fails to register the courses and to attend the classes within the first two weeks time after the start of classes, he/she will not be allowed to attend his/her classes at Level-1 course(s) but his/her admission into the Level-1 of the respective academic session will remain valid up to six weeks.
- If any student fails to report within the first six weeks after the start of classes, his/her admission shall be canceled.

#### Preamble

Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) is a prestigious institution renowned for its excellence in Engineering, Planning, and Architectural education. It offers state-of-the-art facilities, a vibrant academic environment, and numerous opportunities for research and innovation. CUET organizes its annual Admission Test to select talented students for various undergraduate programs. These programs include Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) degrees in multiple Engineering disciplines, Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning (BURP), and Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.). The test is scheduled for Sunday, 25 January 2025, at 10:00 AM, for the academic year 2023-2024. Admission is offered for a limited number of prescribed seats under different faculties.

- CUET provides a wide range of disciplines under its Engineering faculties, including Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Computer Science Engineering, among others. It also offers specialized programs in Urban and Regional Planning and Architecture.
- 920 seats along with 11 reserved seats for trival community.

#### Number of Seats

Number of seats for admission in 4 (four) year B.Sc. in Engineering and BURP (Group “Ka”) and 5 (Five) Year B. Arch (Group “Kha”) under the three Universities (CUET, KUET & RUET) is as follows:

#### Qualifications for Participation in the Admission Test

- Candidate must be a citizen of Bangladesh.
- The candidate must have passed the S.S.C. or equivalent examination from any Secondary & Higher Secondary Education Board/Madrasa Education Board/Technical Education Board of Bangladesh in the year 2020 or 2021 with minimum GPA of 4.00 or equivalent grade.
- Candidate must have passed Higher Secondary/Alim/equivalent examination held in 2023 from any Board of Secondary & Higher Secondary Education/Madrasa Education Board/Board of Technical Education in Bangladesh or GCE 'A' level on or after November 2022. Candidates should have minimum total grade points of 14.00 in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry and a minimum grade point of 3.50 in English; however, the candidate must have minimum total grade points of 18.00 in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English. Besides, for admission in the Biomedical Engineering Department, the concerned candidate must obtain at least grade point 4.00 in Biology in Higher Secondary or equivalent examination.
- Candidates those have passed GCE 'O' level must obtained 'A' grade separately in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English to appear in the admission test examination. And in the GCE 'A' level examination, the candidate must obtain 'A' grades in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics separately. Besides, to get admission in Biomedical Engineering Department, the concerned candidate should get at least 'B' grade in Biology in GCE 'A' level examination.
- Candidates, Bangladesh nationals, who have passed the Higher Secondary/Equivalent Examination held in 2022 from a foreign educational institution with at least 12 academic years of study must obtained at least 80% marks or equivalent grade in the Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and English separately. The concerned candidate must have obtained at least 70% marks in average or equivalent grade in the secondary/equivalent examination.

## Postgraduate Study

Discover advanced postgraduate programs and research opportunities at CUET designed to propel your academic and professional journey forward.

## Elevate Your Career - Apply for Postgraduate Studies at CUET

[Apply Here](/admission/msc/)

### Postgraduate Study Details

The university received a significant number of post graduate students (Masters and PhD) at various degree awarding departments every year. The details of admission for the post graduate program are described below:

#### Degrees Offered

The postgraduate degrees offered by the various departments are as follows-

| Departments | Degrees offered |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Mechanical Engineering | - Master of Science and Engineering (M.Sc. Engg.) - Master of Engineering (M. Engg.) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 2 | Civil Engineering | - Master of Science and Engineering (M.Sc. Engg.) - Master of Engineering (M. Engg.) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 3 | Electrical & Electronic Engineering | - Master of Science and Engineering (M.Sc. Engg.) - Master of Engineering (M. Engg.) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 4 | Computer Science and Engineering | - Master of Science and Engineering (M.Sc. Engg.) - Master of Engineering (M. Engg.) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 5 | Industrial and Production Engineering | - Master of Science and Engineering (M.Sc. Engg.) - Master of Engineering (M. Engg.) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 6 | Mathematics | - Masters of Philosophy (M.Phil) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 7 | Physics | - Masters of Philosophy (M.Phil) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |
| 8 | Chemistry | - Masters of Philosophy (M.Phil) - Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) |

#### Academic Calendar

There are two semesters namely, odd semester and even semester in one academic year. Normally, odd semester is start in April and the even semester in October. Academic progress is measured in terms of credit hours earned by a student. One credit hour for theory course normally requires one hour of class attendance per week in a semester. While one credit hour for thesis, Project and laboratory classes normally requires three hours of work per week in a semester.

#### Admission Procedure

- Applications for admission to the above courses shall be invited through regular means of advertisement and shall be received through prescribed application form.
- There shall be an admission Committee in each department as constituted by the respective PGAC. The admission committee will scrutinize the applications.
- The eligible applicants may be required to appear at a written and/or oral test conducted by the admission committee. The committee, on the basis of the admission test result, will approve a list of prospective postgraduate students for admission into the postgraduate program of the concerned department.
- Every selected candidate for the postgraduate program shall have to get himself/herself admitted/registered to the University within the prescribed time limit on payment of prescribed fees and other dues.
- Eligibility for the admission of foreign students in the aforementioned postgraduate programs shall be examined by the equivalence committee.
- On the recommendation of the appropriate PGAC, the rules for admission into postgraduate courses of the University may be amended from time to time by the Academic council through CASR.

#### Method of Course Offering and Key Instructions

Student in the postgraduate program have to register the course(s) of the current semester within the prescribed time limit on payment of prescribed fees and other dues.

Prior to each registration for any semester, the Adviser/Supervisor will check and approve the students schedule for course(s), prerequisites (if any) and the total credit hours.

A full time M.Sc. Engg./M. Engg./M. Phil student must register a minimum of 12 credit hours and a maximum of 15 credit hours of the theory course per semester. However, a Ph. D. student may register a minimum of 9 credit hours of the theory course per semester.

Student may be allowed to withdraw and/or change his/her registered course(s) within two working weeks from the commencement of that semester on the recommendation of his/her supervisor/advisor and the member-secretary of the concerned PGAC, and upon approval of the concerned course teacher(s) and the head of the department.

| Degrees | Theory | Thesis | Project | Total |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | M.Sc. Engineering | 18 | 18 | -- | 36 |
| 2 | M. Engineering | 30 | -- | 06 | 36 |
| 3 | M.Phil | 24 | 24 | -- | 48 |
| 4 | Ph.D | 06 | 45 | -- | 54 |

#### Examinations

Class tests, assignments and/or examination during the semester given by the teachers(s) concerned, there will be a written examination at the end of the semester for each of the courses offered in that semester. The dates of such examination will be announced by the Head of the respective department at least two weeks before the commencement of the examinations. The final grade in a subject will be based on the performance in all tests, assignments and/or examinations.

#### Key Instructions for Thesis/Project for M.Sc. Engineering/M. Engg./M. Phil degree

- Research work for a thesis/project shall be carried out under the supervision of a full-time teacher of the department, not below the rank of Assistant Professor preferably having Ph.D. degree.
- PGAC of the department will recommend the supervisor for a student in the middle of the first semester. A co-supervisor (if necessary) from within or outside the department/University may also be recommended.
- The appointment of the supervisor and co-supervisor (if any), and the tentative research proposal of thesis/project written under the guidance of the supervisor(s) shall be approved by the CASR on recommendation of PGAC at the end of the first semester of a full-time student.
- The research work must be carried out in this University. In special circumstances, it may be carried out at a place(s) recommended by the supervisor in consultation with the Head of the department and approved by the CASR.
- A seminar shall have to be presented by M. Sc. Engg/ M. Phil student on the progress of his/her research work, within the next semester after completion of coursework. The Head of the department will keep a record of it and send a copy of the same to the Vice-Chancellor in prescribed form.
- Every student shall submit to the Head of the department, through his/her supervisor a required number of printed copies of his/her thesis/project report in the approved format on or before a date to be fixed by the supervisor in consultation with the Head of the department concerned.
- The students have to certify that the research work was done by him/her and the same work has not been submitted elsewhere for any degree or award (except for publication).
- The thesis/project should demonstrate evidence of satisfactory knowledge in the field of research undertaken by the student and must be an original contribution to engineering/science and worth of publication.

#### Key Instructions for Ph. D degree

- Research work for a thesis will be carried out under the supervision of a full time teacher, having Ph. D. Degree of the department. PGAC of the department will recommend the supervisor for a student in the middle of the first semester. A co-supervisor (if necessary) from within or outside the department/University may also be recommended. The appointment of the supervisor, co-supervisor (if any), and the title of thesis will be approved by the CASR on recommendation of PGAC at the end of first semester of a full time student.
- If any change in research proposal of the thesis, the supervisor and co-supervisor (if any) is unavoidable it should be approved by the CASR on recommendation of PGAC. In such a case, if the student fails to complete the program within the specified time limit, the student may get an extension for not more than one academic year.
- Every student submitting a thesis in partial fulfilment of the requirement of a Ph.D. degree will be required to appear at an oral examination, on a date or dates fixed by the supervisor in consultation with Head of the department and must satisfy the examiners that he/she is capable of intelligently applying the results of this research to the solution of problems, of undertaking independent work, and also afford evidence of satisfactory knowledge related to the theory and technique used in his/her research work.
- On receipt of favourable experts report, the supervisor in consultation with Head of the department shall propose to the Vice-Chancellor, for the approval of Academic Council, a panel of examiners for thesis and oral examination, usually one month before the date of thesis examination.
- The thesis should demonstrate and evidence of satisfactory knowledge in the field of research undertaken by the student and must be an original contribution to engineering/science and worthy of publication. In support of this the student should have at least two publications in Journal of International standard.

#### Ph.D

Every Ph.D. Student shall appear at a comprehensive examination, ordinarily held soon after the completion of the course requirements. The PGAC will form an examination committee named Doctoral scrutiny Committee (DSC) and will be constituted as follows:

| Particulars | Positions | Remarks |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Supervisor | Chairman |  |
| 2 | Co-Supervisor | Member |  |
| 3 | Head of the department | Member |  |
| 4 | One expert member with Ph. D. degree in the relevant field from outside the University | Expert Member | Two alternate names should be proposed. |
| 5 | Two members from within or outside the department, not below the rank of Assistant Professor having Ph. D. degree | Member | Three alternate names should be proposed. |

The date and time of the comprehensive examination shall be fixed by the PGAC on the request of the supervisor. The comprehensive examination shall comprise a written examination and/or an oral examination to test the knowledge of the student related to the subject(s) of his research and allied fields. If a student fails to qualify in a comprehensive examination, he shall be given one more chance to appear in the examination as scheduled by the PGAC. The Head of the department will send a report of the comprehensive examination in prescribed form, to the Vice-Chancellor.

#### M.Sc. Engg./M.Engg./M.Phil

| Particulars | Positions | Remarks |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Supervisor | Chairman |  |
| 2 | Co-Supervisor | Member |  |
| 3 | Head of the department | Member |  |
| 4 | One external member from outside the department/University | External Member | Two alternate names should be proposed. |
| 5 | One or two members from within or outside the department, not below the rank of Assistant Professor, having research experience. | Member | Three alternate names should be proposed. |

#### Key Qualifying Requirements

- Upon successful completion of the coursework, every student will submit a thesis on his/her research work or a report on his/her project work fulfilling the requirements.
- M. Sc. Engg/ M. Phil students must have a conference paper and should preferably have one publication in a referred Journal from his/her thesis work.
- Ph. D. students must have at least three conference papers and should have at least two publications from his/her thesis work in a referred Journal.

#### Grading System

Letter grade system will be applied in assessment of the performance of a student in semester examination. Numerical marking may be made in answer scripts but all final gradings to be reported to the Head of the department in prescribed form, shall be in the letter grade as outlined below:

| Marks obtain | Grades | Description | Points |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 90% and above | A+ | Excellent | 4.00 |
| 80% to below 90% | A | Very good | 3.50 |
| 70% to below 80% | B+ | Good | 3.00 |
| 60% to below 70% | B | Average | 2.50 |
| 50% to below 60% | C | Pass | 2.00 |
| Below 50% | F | Fail | 0.00 |
|  | I | Incomplete |  |
|  | S | Satisfactory |  |
|  | U | Unsatisfactory |  |

text:
## **Research Highlights**

 As a leading engineering university, the institution is dedicated to advancing cutting-edge research that drives technological innovation, industrial development, and sustainable solutions for national and global challenges.

- **Engineering-Driven Innovation:** Strong emphasis on applied and theoretical research in core engineering disciplines.
- **Advanced Laboratories:** Modern research laboratories equipped with state-of-the-art instruments and simulation facilities.
- **Industry & Government Collaboration:** Active partnerships with industries, research organizations, and government bodies.
- **Graduate & Doctoral Research:** Robust MSc, MEng, and PhD research programs producing high-impact publications.
- **Technology Transfer & Prototyping:** Research outputs translated into prototypes, patents, and real-world engineering solutions.
- **International Research Engagement:** Collaborative research projects and joint publications with global universities.

 The university fosters a strong research culture that integrates education, innovation, and societal impact to support sustainable engineering development.

title: research / research-area
text:
## **Research Areas**

 Research activities are organized across major engineering and applied science domains, encouraging interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation.

- **Civil Engineering:** Structural Engineering, Transportation Systems, Geotechnical Engineering, Water Resources, and Environmental Engineering.
- **Mechanical Engineering:** Thermal Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Materials Engineering, Robotics, and Energy Systems.
- **Electrical & Electronic Engineering:** Power Systems, Renewable Energy, Control Systems, Signal Processing, and Microelectronics.
- **Computer Science & Engineering:** Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and Computer Networks.
- **Biomedical Engineering:** Biomedical Signal Processing, Medical Devices, Neuroengineering, and Healthcare Technology.
- **Materials & Chemical Engineering:** Nanomaterials, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Process Design, and Sustainable Materials.
- **Energy & Sustainability:** Renewable Energy, Smart Grids, Energy Efficiency, and Climate-Resilient Infrastructure.

 These research areas reflect the university’s mission to produce innovative engineers, impactful research outcomes, and technology-driven solutions for society.

title: Center for Environmental Science & Engineering Research
text:
## About

The Center for Environmental Science & Engineering Research (CESER) is the oldest center of CUET focuses the research on all aspect of Environmental Science and Engineering topics in the context to Global Environmental Challenges and Sustainable Development. In this regard, the center is working for developing local environmental manpower and expertise in order to enhance the economic growth of the country without damaging the quality of the environment, to promote and provide facilities for offering consultation services to development agencies and partners in matters of environmental relevance. The center is committed to develop an environmental management information system (EMIS) within the center to facilitate collection and dissemination of information and training materials to institutions that train environmental professionals. The center is also working to help in formulating the codes of practices for a cleaner and greener environment.

## Vision

**Aims & Objectives of the Center **

The overall aim of the Center is to create a Center of Excellence with state of art research facilities and study in the area of Environmental Science and Engineering. In this regard the followings shall be the objectives of the Center:

a) To promote and provide facilities for
i. Post graduate diploma and certificate programs for the professionals
ii. Advanced studies and research facilities for students, teachers and professionals
iii. Developing local environmental manpower and expertise in order to enhance the economic growth of the country without damaging the quality of the environment
iv. Mainstreaming environmental dimension within the processes of planning, design, implementation, operation and maintenance of development projects
v. Developing capacity for environmental research in order to support environmentally sound development programs in the country
vi. Training and education to technologist, managers, decision makers, academician and other concerned officials in sound management approaches, parallel to technological and least cost solutions to the environmental problems
vii. Providing specific project oriented training to professionals of industries and other development agencies within the energy sector
viii. Offering consultation services to development agencies and partners in matters of environmental relevance
ix. Conducting research in areas of global and national environmental problems, and
x. Developing an environmental management information system (EMIS) within the center to facilitate collection and dissemination of information and training materials to institutions that train environmental professionals.

b) To provide necessary forum for professional engineers and policy & decision makers to exchange ideas in the field of environmental science and engineering both at home and abroad

c) To help in formulating the codes of practices for cleaner and greener environment:
i. Bangladesh Standards for environmental quality (e.g. air quality, water quality, wastewater quality, noise quality, sediment quality and etc.)
ii. Bangladesh Standard Code of Practice for plumbing system for residential commercial and industrial building
iii. Bangladesh Standard Code of Practice for water and wastewater treatment plant design, and
iv. Bangladesh Standard Code of Practice for Environmental Impact assessment

## Mission

**Mission**
The Center for Environmental Science and Engineering Research (CESER) will be established to provide world class research facilities to achieve “Center of Excellence”. It would be guided by an Advisory Committee of leading environmental practitioners and is committed to conduct research at advanced level. The Center is expected to create state-of-the-art research facilities covering all aspect of Environmental Science and Engineering topics in the context to Global Environmental Challenges.
The Center is also committed to develop curriculum, code, standard, guideline and regulation for a safer and cleaner environment. The center will also be involved in the public awareness building program in relation to Environmental issues subjected to national and international interest.

## Message from the Head

Environmental science is an interdisciplinary academic field that integrates physical, chemical, biological and information sciences to the study of the environment and the solution of environmental problems. Environmental engineering focuses on design and technology to improve environmental quality in everyday life. Now-a –days global warming is a buzz issue that is caused due to anthropogenic environmental pollution. With the rapid changes, there is a need to study each step that may alter the environment so that the natural ecosystem may still be protected or replaced by a better one. The purpose of this center is to strengthen environmental governance that will lead to the adoption of improved environmental practices, technologies, and services, particularly in addressing air pollution, water and waste management challenges.

## Laboratories

Center for Environmental Science & Engineering Research (CESER)’s laboratory has the following equipments:

i. Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer-200

ii. Portable Spectrophotometer

iii. Portable Bacteriological kit

iv. Portable/Bench top Digital Multipara Meter.

v. Magnetic Stirrer

vi. Distilled Water Unit

vii. Filtration System

viii. Group Heater

 ix. Digital Arsenometer

x.  Water Quality Meter

 xi. pH Meter

 xii. Turbidity Meter

## About

The Institute of Information and Communication Technology (IICT) is dedicated to advancing postgraduate education, research, and professional training in ICT to develop skilled manpower and knowledge-based solutions for national growth. Through its Academic and System & Support wings, IICT provides modern ICT infrastructure, develops university software systems, and offers industry-relevant training programs to meet evolving technological demands.

Below, the works and responsibilities of IICT are presented in detail.

### **1. Academic Activities**

IICT offers Post-graduate Degree and Diplomas in different subjects of ICT.

### **1.1 Degree Programs**

- Offer **Postgraduate Diploma programs in ICT**.
- Offer (proposed) **M.Sc. Engg. / M. Engg. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering**.
- Offer (proposed) **M.Sc. Engg. / M. Engg. in Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics**.

### **1.2 Training Programs**

- Conduct training under **Enhancing Digital Government and Economy (EDGE)** initiative.
- Provide training in **Basic Networking**.
- Provide training in **Full Stack Software Development**.

## **2. IT Infrastructure Management**

The CUET campus network has an upward of 6,000 active users. This sheer number of users in one network is much higher than any commercial ISP supports in Bangladesh.

### **2.1 Wi-Fi Network Management**

- Setup, maintain, and provide support for Wi-Fi in:

  - Academic buildings
  - Administrative buildings
  - Student residential halls
  - Library
  - Auditorium, cafeteria, TSC, and medical center
  - Teacher & Officer residential areas (single and family units)
  - Staff residential areas (single and family units)

### **2.2 LAN Management**

- Setup, maintain, and support LAN connectivity in:

  - Academic buildings
  - Administrative buildings
  - Student residential halls
  - Library
  - Teacher & Officer residential areas (single and family units)
  - Staff residential areas (single and family units)
  - additional internet connectivity across the campus where needed.

### **2.3 Internet and Backbone Infrastructure**

- Manage **data uplinks and redundant internet connections**.
- Maintain **campus backbone network using optical fiber**.
- Manage **data servers**

  - **On-Premises **
  - **Cloud based**

- Configure and maintain **firewalls and security systems**.
- Perform **bandwidth management and traffic control**.
- Monitor and resolve system security threats.

## **3. Software and Application Services**

- Provide technical support for **email configuration and usage**.

### **3.2 Website Services**

- Maintain and update the **university official website**.
- Provide continuous **technical support for web services**.

### **3.3 Online Application Systems**

- Develop and maintain:

  - Undergraduate course management system
  - Post Graduate course management system (developing)

  - Undergraduate MCQ Based Result Processing System.
  - Undergraduate Written Based Result Processing System.

### **3.4 Custom Software Development**

- Develop & maintain:

  - Conference Application management Systems for multiple academic departments (CIVIL, MECHANICAL, MATHEMETICS).
  - Custom applications for academic and administrative operations
  - Automation tools for university administrative workflows.
  - Custom software development services for external organizations.
  - Software Quality Assurance (SQA) services for software systems developed within the university as well as for external software projects.

### **3.5 Office Applications**

- Provide **Microsoft Office services for faculty members**.

- Provide **Office applications for administrative offices**.

## **4. Security Infrastructure**

- Maintain and monitor **campus-wide CCTV surveillance systems**.

- Upgrade infrastructure to include **additional surveillance cameras**.
- Perform:

  - Camera setup and maintenance

  - NVR and DVR system maintenance
  - Backup and on-demand video export
  - Ensure continuous power supply for remote camera locations

## **5. ID Card Services**

  - Students
  - Faculty members
  - Officers

- Maintain **centralized ID card database**.

  - Laptops

  - UPS

- Troubleshooting support for IT related hardware and software's

- Prepare **technical specifications for ICT equipment procurement**.
- Develop and process **tender documents**.
- Conduct **inspection and verification of procured equipment**.

title: Nuclear Engineering
text:
## About

Welcome to the Department of Nuclear Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), a pioneering institution dedicated to advancing knowledge and expertise in nuclear engineering and technology within the context of Bangladesh. Our department assumes a pivotal role in shaping future leaders in the field, offering comprehensive academic programs spanning from undergraduate to doctoral levels. With an unwavering commitment to academic excellence, research, and societal service, we aspire to make significant contributions to the development of Bangladesh's nuclear infrastructure. Explore our website to gain insights into our educational offerings, research endeavors, and the accomplished faculty and students who constitute our vibrant academic community. Join us in the collective pursuit of excellence in nuclear engineering at CUET. In addressing the challenges of the 21st century and aligning with the government's vision to advance Bangladesh, Nuclear Engineering assumes a pivotal role. Professionals in this domain focus on harnessing energy from nuclear reactions. Bangladesh is progressively incorporating nuclear engineering for diverse applications, spanning power generation, medicine, and industrial and agricultural processes. The effective management of nuclear infrastructure and materials necessitates the presence of skilled professionals. The initiation of nuclear engineering and technology education at CUET fulfils this imperative, aligning with CUET's distinguished role in higher education, research, and development in engineering and applied sciences in Bangladesh. The Department of Nuclear Engineering (NE) at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) was established in February 2019 under the esteemed faculty of Engineering and Technology.

## Vision

The Nuclear Engineering Department at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology aims to excel globally in higher education for the peaceful applications of nuclear energy while serving as a centre of excellence in education, research, and technical support and creating man power for the country's nuclear power program.

## Mission

- **Academic Excellence: **Cultivate highly proficient nuclear engineers across educational levels, from undergraduate to postgraduate, empowering them to contribute substantive engineering acumen to the design, construction, and operation of Bangladesh's nuclear power plants. Fostering a diverse and inclusive community of scholars, professionals and students dedicated to advancing the peaceful and beneficial uses of nuclear technology for the betterment of society.
- **Centre of Academic Distinction:** Strive to achieve recognition as a distinguished academic centre for nuclear engineering and technology, encompassing nuclear power, nuclear medicine, and nuclear applications in agriculture. Dedicate efforts to provide exceptional education, conduct impactful research, and extend meaningful outreach initiatives. The centre also offers technical expertise and professional support to advance Bangladesh’s nuclear infrastructure, promote the safe and effective use of nuclear power in the national energy landscape, enhance healthcare through nuclear medicine, and support sustainable agricultural development through peaceful nuclear technologies.
- **Nuclear Research Facility Development: **Committed to the development of a modern Nuclear Research Facility to support advanced education, cutting-edge research, and innovation in nuclear science and technology. The facility will enhance capabilities in nuclear power, radiation applications, nuclear medicine, and agricultural technologies while ensuring the highest standards of safety and regulatory compliance.
- **Public and Professional Engagement:** Undertake service initiatives for industry, government, professional bodies, and the wider public, focusing on areas pertinent to nuclear and radiological engineering. Promoting nuclear safety, security, and non-proliferation through rigorous research, education, and outreach efforts.

## Message from the Head

As the Head of the Department of Nuclear Engineering at the Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET), I have the honour of overseeing a distinguished assembly of educators and scholars. The establishment of the Department of Nuclear Engineering signifies a deliberate response to the escalating demand for proficient engineers and researchers, particularly within the increasing field of nuclear-related activities, specifically in power generation. Our department is dedicated in its commitment to shaping aspiring individuals into expert technical leaders, thereby contributing to the cultivation of skilled professionals in the domain of nuclear engineering. Dedicated to delivering a comprehensive education in Nuclear Engineering, our curriculum ensures a robust foundation and offers specialized studies in Nuclear and Reactor Physics, Nuclear Reactor and System Design, Nuclear Power Plant Engineering, and Nuclear Fuel Cycle. We emphasize the importance of a well-rounded education for success in the field, preparing students for national and international excellence. A key objective of our department is to foster advanced studies and research in nuclear engineering for postgraduate (Diploma), M.S., M.Sc., and Ph.D. degrees, complemented by structured training and post-doctoral research. Our programs equip individuals with skills and knowledge relevant to nuclear power generation, nuclear medicine, nuclear food preservation, and applications in construction and workforce industries. In addition to our educational endeavours, we are dedicated to advancing Nuclear Engineering knowledge through ongoing research projects. Actively seeking collaborations with industrial partners, government agencies, and academic institutions, we aim to be a global centre of excellence in nuclear engineering, contributing to effective and peaceful applications in power generation, nuclear medicine, agriculture, and industry. As the Head of the Department of Nuclear Engineering, I eagerly anticipate collaborating with our faculty, staff, students, and industrial partners to further our vision of excellence.

title: Materials and Metallurgical Engineering
text:
## About

The Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering (MME) at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) was established in the 2019-2020 academic session with the goal of fostering excellence in the fields of materials science and metallurgy. Beginning its journey with just 30 undergraduate students, the department has continued to evolve and expand, maintaining a strong commitment to producing skilled engineers who are equipped with both theoretical knowledge and practical expertise. The purpose of the MME Department is to prepare students for the challenges of modern industry by providing a comprehensive understanding of materials—from their fundamental properties to their applications in real-world engineering problems. The department strives to bridge the gap between material science and engineering applications, ensuring that students develop the necessary skills to innovate, design, and optimize materials for a variety of industrial sectors.

## Vision

The vision of the MME Department is to become a leading hub for education and research in materials and metallurgical engineering, producing graduates who are capable of making significant contributions to technological advancements and innovation in the field. The department envisions empowering students to drive the future of industries by mastering the complexities of materials science and metallurgy while adhering to global standards and sustainable practices.
Each year, the department admits 30 students per batch for the B.Sc. in Materials and Metallurgical Engineering (MME), ensuring a focused and hands-on learning environment where students receive personalized attention and are well-prepared for their careers. Through a rigorous curriculum, cutting-edge research, and a focus on practical skills, the MME Department at CUET is shaping the next generation of materials engineers.

## Mission

The mission of the MME Department at CUET is to:

Provide high-quality education in materials and metallurgical engineering, focusing on both the theoretical foundations and practical applications.
Foster research and innovation in the areas of materials processing, characterization, and advanced manufacturing.
Equip students with the necessary tools to contribute to sustainable development through the responsible use of materials in industries like aerospace, automotive, energy, and electronics.
Encourage interdisciplinary collaboration and teamwork among students to solve complex engineering problems.

## Message from the Head

The Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering (MME) at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology began its journey in 2019. Over the years, it has grown to accommodate over 150 students, dedicated to learning and research in materials and metallurgy. The department focuses on developing materials with advanced properties, addressing the demands of modern engineering fields such as nanotechnology, electronics, biomedical applications, automotive, and aerospace industries. With a strong foundation in science and engineering, students gain hands-on experience in materials characterization and processing, preparing them for diverse career opportunities and research endeavors.

Our vision is to foster innovation and creativity among students, empowering them to drive advancements in materials science. We are committed to tackling global challenges in energy, sustainability, and healthcare by developing cutting-edge materials. With a dynamic learning environment and a passion for discovery, MME welcomes aspiring engineers and researchers to join us in shaping the future of materials technology.

Prof. Dr. Md. Mamunur Roshid

## Laboratories

The Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering (MME) is equipped with a comprehensive suite of modern laboratories that support both teaching and research across a wide spectrum of materials science and engineering. These laboratories—including the Nano-fabrication Lab, Surface Engineering Lab, Materials Characterization Lab, Glass and Ceramics Lab, Wet Synthesis Lab, Polymer and Composite Lab, Metallography Lab, High Temperature Processing Lab, Materials Testing Lab, and HPC & Simulation Lab—provide an integrated platform for understanding materials from fundamental principles to advanced applications.

Through a combination of experimental facilities and computational tools, students and researchers gain hands-on experience in materials synthesis, processing, characterization, testing, and simulation. The laboratories are designed to bridge theory and practice, enabling the exploration of structure–property–performance relationships across multiple length scales.

## About

Welcome to the Department of Mathematics at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET). We started our journey in the year of 1968. Over the last five decades, we have grown our expertise and competence in the engineering-related curriculum and core mathematics research. The subject of Mathematics has numerous contributions to designing the Mathematical Model of modern Engineering problems. With the help of basic Mathematical knowledge, students are able to understand the logical system in their application sectors to tackle the real world problems. The primary focus of our curriculum is to impart mathematical technical know-how to students, promote their problem solving skills and innovation of new technologies.
    We have a strong postgraduate level, we offer MPhil and Ph.D. in Mathematics by research. The main goal of this program is to produce quality researchers in Mathematics. The sanctioned students’ strengths of MPhil and Ph.D. by research are 10 and 5 respectively each year. However, it varies with the quality candidates. At present, the department has 08 Ph.D. and 20 MPhil scholars. Students are mostly faculty members from different colleges and universities carry out their postgraduate studies. Besides this, our department managed several undergraduate courses in the different engineering departments at CUET.
  The postgraduate course contents are periodically updated for introducing new Mathematical concepts and logical developments. Postgraduate students are encouraged to undertake various research projects. Our department maintains active research groups for carrying out collaborative and interdisciplinary research. We have state of the art research facilities to support our academic programs and research. Funding is available for research from government and universities' internal sources for students and faculties.
    The Department of Mathematics established a sophisticated Simulation Lab supported by the World Bank through the University Grand Commission (UGC) under the project HEQEP (Higher Education Quality Enhancement Project). The Simulation Lab unveils new opportunities for graduate students to carry on their research with modern computational software in Mathematical Modeling and Simulation.   Our departments’ faculty members are always careful about teaching and research. Faculty members have excellent academic credentials and are highly regarded. They have been conferred with many prestigious awards at national and international levels. Several faculty members serve on the editorial boards of national and international journals, review technical articles for journals on a regular basis, and organize international symposia and conferences.

This department homepage provides an overview of the academic programs, research activities of our department, research facilities, profiles of faculty members, and details of student activities. If you have further questions after browsing this page, please do not hesitate to contact us. The contact details are given below. You may also correspond with individual faculty members, or contact them by email, using the addresses shown on the faculty pages as your need. Our department looks forward to contributing to solving mathematical problems related to the technological challenges of society with active participation from all sections of society. Thank you for visiting our departmental page.

## Vision

The vision of our department is to provide quality education and research in Pure and Applied Mathematics which help us to establish as a center of excellence at the national and international level.

## Mission

As an independent Department and a part of an Engineering University, the Department of Mathematics has following mission: ---To provide quality education primarily in the undergraduate level in different engineering branches as they are able to effectively apply their mathematical logical cognition to solve real-world problems. --- To conduct high quality research at the postgraduate level with an aim to advance knowledge of Pure and applied Mathematics as they become assets of our country. --- To develop new ideas in research and create collaboration with other departments and universities at home and abroad.

## Message from the Head

On behalf of all faculties, staffs and students of the department of Mathematics, I would like to welcome you all to our Department. Everyone knows a little bit of math. Minimum mathematical knowledge is essential for managing life properly. Those who are deprived of education also know how to count. No man can survive without mathematics. Not only human beings but all the creatures of the world have the minimum knowledge of mathematics. Everything from microscopic bacteria to plants, the sky, the air, the planets and stars have a touch of mathematics. It is not possible to keep anything running without mathematical rules. Human civilization has improved with the advancement of mathematics. Many of us do not know this. What we do not know is that behind all that is aesthetically pleasing in our environment lies the proper application of mathematical reasoning. But in childhood, mathematics is presented to us as a scary subject. And its effect lasts a lifetime. Even Einstein said himself “Do not worry too much about your difficulties in mathematics, I can assure you that mine are still greater.”
  The Department of Mathematics at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) was launched with the aim of preparing students and researchers in Mathematics with a width of knowledge of the other sciences and technologies. Besides the offered MPhil and PhD research areas in Mathematics Department, we are responsible for the undergraduate mathematics courses of different engineering branches at CUET.
  In the year 2015, we successfully organized National Conference on Mathematics and Application (NCMA-2015). We have plan to organize an International Conference in Dec’2021 to provide a platform to the researcher in national and international arena to present their research. Seminar/ webinar will also be organized by the department with the help of Mathematical Society and CUET administration. A Math Club will be launched soon to help programming students and to organize Math Olympiad and other contest on behalf of the department to overcome Math phobia of CUET students.
  We are focusing to form an Alumni Association to make a connection to our graduates with their Alma mater.

title: Department of Chemistry
text:
## About

The **Department of Chemistry at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET)** is a vibrant academic and research community dedicated to excellence in chemistry education, fundamental and applied research, innovation, and technological development. We strive to create an inspiring and inclusive environment where students, faculty, researchers, and staff can explore new ideas, develop their potential, and contribute meaningfully to academia, industry, and society.

With a **history spanning more than five decades**, the Department has played an important role in providing students from various engineering disciplines with a strong foundation in chemistry—the **central science that connects engineering, technology, medicine, agriculture, environmental science, materials science, and many other fields**. Our undergraduate chemistry education emphasizes both fundamental concepts and practical laboratory skills, enabling students to understand the principles of chemistry and apply them to real-world technological and engineering challenges.

The Department is committed not only to teaching but also to **advancing knowledge through high-quality research and innovation**. Our research activities cover a broad spectrum of contemporary areas, including **environmental chemistry, natural product chemistry, nanochemistry, materials science, computational chemistry, biological chemistry, surface science, polymer science, electrochemistry, theoretical chemistry**, and other emerging interdisciplinary fields. Through these activities, we seek to address important scientific, environmental, technological, and societal challenges at both national and global levels.

### Graduate and Postgraduate Education

The Department expanded its academic portfolio by introducing **M.Phil. and Ph.D. programs in Chemistry in 2009**, providing opportunities for advanced research and the development of future leaders in chemical sciences. Subsequently, the **M.Sc. program was introduced in 2017**, further strengthening the Department's graduate education and research capacity.

Our graduate and postgraduate programs are designed for students who are passionate about chemistry and motivated to pursue advanced scientific research. Students have opportunities to work closely with experienced faculty members in interdisciplinary research environments, develop advanced experimental and analytical skills, publish scientific research, and contribute to the development of innovative solutions to contemporary challenges.

### Research, Innovation, and Collaboration

We believe that the future of chemistry lies at the intersection of **fundamental science, engineering, technology, and innovation**. Therefore, the Department encourages interdisciplinary research and collaboration with academic institutions, industries, government organizations, and national and international research communities.

Our goal is to transform scientific knowledge into practical solutions in areas such as **sustainable materials, environmental protection, clean water, emerging contaminants, advanced oxidation processes, energy, nanotechnology, and other areas of strategic importance**.

### Commitment to Industry and Society

In addition to our academic and research activities, the Department contributes to industry and society through **professional testing, analytical, and consultancy services**. These activities provide technical support to industries, organizations, researchers, and other stakeholders while creating opportunities for our faculty and researchers to engage with real-world scientific and technological challenges.

We consider our engagement with industry and society an integral part of our mission. It enables us to translate academic expertise into practical solutions while continuously strengthening our capacity to address the evolving technological challenges of the twenty-first century.

### Looking Ahead

As we move forward, the Department of Chemistry remains committed to building a **center of excellence in chemistry education, research, and innovation**. We aim to nurture scientifically competent, creative, ethical, and globally competitive graduates and researchers who can contribute to sustainable technological development and address the challenges facing Bangladesh and the world.

**We warmly welcome students, researchers, academics, industry partners, and collaborators to join our journey of learning, discovery, innovation, and service.**

**Welcome to the Department of Chemistry at CUET—where chemistry meets engineering, innovation, and the future.**

## Vision

To be a **nationally and internationally recognized center of excellence in chemistry education, research, and innovation**, producing highly skilled, ethical, and creative graduates and researchers who contribute to scientific advancement, technological innovation, environmental sustainability, and the socio-economic development of Bangladesh and the global community.

## Mission

The Department of Chemistry, CUET is committed to:

**Providing high-quality, innovative, and student-centered education** in chemistry that develops strong theoretical knowledge, practical skills, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

**Promoting cutting-edge research and innovation** in fundamental and applied chemistry to address emerging scientific, technological, environmental, and societal challenges.

**Developing competent and ethical professionals, researchers, and future leaders** equipped with the knowledge, skills, creativity, and integrity required to contribute effectively to academia, industry, research organizations, and society.

**Advancing interdisciplinary and collaborative research** by fostering national and international partnerships with academic institutions, industries, government organizations, and research communities.

**Promoting sustainable chemistry and environmentally responsible technologies** to address challenges related to clean water, environmental pollution, energy, climate change, health, and sustainable development.

**Encouraging innovation, entrepreneurship, and technology transfer** to transform scientific knowledge and research outcomes into practical solutions for national and global needs.

**Creating an inclusive, safe, and intellectually stimulating academic environment** that encourages lifelong learning, scientific curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and professional development.

**Contributing to national development and the advancement of society** through excellence in education, research, innovation, knowledge dissemination, and community engagement.

## Message from the Head

**Welcome to the Department of Chemistry at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET).**

Chemistry is often described as the central science because it connects and contributes to almost every aspect of our lives. From the materials we use and the medicines we depend on to clean water, energy, agriculture, environmental protection, and advanced technologies, **chemistry is fundamental to understanding and shaping the world around us**. In an era of rapid scientific and technological transformation, chemistry continues to serve as a powerful driving force behind innovations in engineering, medicine, agriculture, environmental science, energy, and materials technology.

The **Department of Chemistry at CUET** is committed to excellence in education, research, innovation, and the development of skilled human resources. The Department provides a stimulating academic and research environment for undergraduate students from different engineering disciplines, as well as graduate and postgraduate students. We strive to develop a strong foundation in chemical sciences while encouraging students to think critically, explore creatively, and apply their knowledge to real-world challenges.

The Department offers **M.Sc., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs in Chemistry**, providing opportunities for advanced study and research across a broad range of contemporary and interdisciplinary areas. Our research encompasses **environmental chemistry, natural product chemistry, nanochemistry, materials science, computational chemistry, biological chemistry, surface science, polymer science, electrochemistry, theoretical chemistry**, and other emerging fields. Through these research activities, we aim to generate new knowledge and develop innovative solutions to pressing national and global challenges.

Our greatest strength is our **dedicated faculty members, researchers, and staff**, who are highly qualified, enthusiastic, cooperative, and committed to academic and research excellence. We believe that a supportive and inclusive academic environment is essential for nurturing curiosity, creativity, integrity, and scientific excellence. Accordingly, we encourage close interaction among students, faculty, and researchers and promote interdisciplinary collaboration both within CUET and with national and international institutions.

As a department within an engineering-focused university, we particularly value the integration of **chemistry with engineering and technology**. Our goal is not only to teach chemistry but also to empower our students and researchers to translate chemical knowledge into practical technologies and sustainable solutions. We are committed to addressing contemporary challenges such as **environmental pollution, emerging contaminants, clean water, sustainable materials, energy, public health, and climate change** through innovative research and collaboration.

We warmly welcome students, researchers, academics, industries, and collaborators to engage with our Department. Whether you are seeking a strong academic foundation, an opportunity for advanced research, interdisciplinary collaboration, or a platform for innovation, we hope you will find the Department of Chemistry at CUET an inspiring place to learn, discover, and contribute.

**Together, we aspire to nurture a generation of scientifically skilled engineers, chemists, researchers, and innovators who will create meaningful discoveries, develop sustainable technologies, and contribute to a better future for Bangladesh and the world.**

Once again, **welcome to the Department of Chemistry at CUET**. We look forward to learning, discovering, and innovating together.

## About

**"Physics is the liberal arts education for a technological society." - Joseph Pimbley**

The Department of Physics of Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) is committed to ensure quality education. All faculty members of this department are involved in research activities to keep themselves updated always with the world’s research innovation. This department is one of the initial and vital departments of the Faculty of Engineering & Technology of CUET and started its journey as an independent department in the year 1968. The Department of Physics designs theoretical and experimental courses to equip undergraduate students to develop the basic scientific skills so that they can get themselves prepared to face the chronologically additive challenges of upcoming world. The department introduced postgraduate programs Master of Philosophy (M. Phil.) in the year 2001-2002, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in the year 2009-2010 and Masters (M.Sc.) in Physics (Research based) in the year 2017-18. Focusing on research excellence the best out come within its funding limitation is a prime objective of this department. Present research scopes of the department are available in Nuclear and Health Physics, Condensed Matter Physics, Atmospheric Physics, Nanophysics and Applications. Beyond these, some courses in ICT and Physics Education are also offered in the postgraduate level. Recently, more wings of advanced research have been created through both national and international collaboration with other research institutes and Universities.

Prospective and interested students are cordially welcome to our postgraduate research programs (M.Sc., M.Phil. and Ph.D.).

## Vision

The Physics Department aspires to be always focused on the core of academic achievements of our university with excellence in Physical sciences. The ultimate vision of the department is to build up a knowledge- based scientific community nationwide with an emphasis on social, democratic and ethical values.

## Mission

The mission of the Department of Physics is mainly oriented to the development of innovative curricula by providing high-quality teaching, learning and analytical experience. Also, the department has its objective to accumulate knowledge from different branches of Physics through continuous improvement of the quality of scientific research, developing and sharing it with the scientific community; becoming a centre of attraction in the national and international arenas through its undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

## Message from the Head

The ultimate efforts of the Department of Physics are based on teaching and research, as expected from a university department. In order to achieve research impact, all teachers along with the postgraduate students are dedicatedly involved in quality research works in their individual area of interest. As a result, the environment in the Department is highly collaborative, with close interaction between the different research groups in terms of sharing resources and providing peer-instruction to the students of postgraduate programs. This allowed a critical mass of research effort in a small department and considerable successes in terms of highly cited publications and postgraduate degrees awarded. We also offer physics courses in both theoretical and experimental to the undergraduate students of other degree awarding departments of this university.

In the year 2009, the Department organized a national conference at our university campus with a variety of scopes in physical sciences and technology. Since the year 2015, the Department has been organizing “International Conference on Physics for Sustainable Development and Technology (ICPSDT)” as a two-yearly regular event. Eminent scientists and researchers from home and abroad participate in every conference to share their innovative ideas and distinguished research works with all other participants. The ICPSDT, undoubtedly, has been playing an important role as a ground of knowledge sharing and building functional communication amongst prospective researchers around the world.

We believe that our commitment to ensure quality teaching will keep strengthening our efforts to find this Department as an icon of physics education in near future.
