title: Urban and Regional Planning
text:
## About

As the geographical location of the institution is in a hilly region, the scope of planning and its application has been widened to new dimension that distinguishes unique identity from other institutions. Tourism and Recreational Planning in hilly region like Chittagong, the commercial capital of Bangladesh will contribute a lot to national economy.

The Department of Urban and Regional Planning (DURP) has been established in 2009 under the faculty of Architecture and Planning, offering Bachelor degree in Urban and Regional Planning. In view of meeting the growing demand of planners in government and nongovernment organizations, universities and research institutes, DURP has introduced this bachelor program. Under this program 30 students are enrolled each year. At least 159 credit hours must be completed within 4 academic years to fulfill the entire requirement of this degree.

DURP at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) is primarily concerned with the development planning at the urban, rural, regional and local levels. Besides this program encourages its students to develop specializations within the field of urban planning, rural planning, transportation planning, housing and real estate development, disaster management and environmental planning, tourism and recreation planning and to expand their intellectual horizons through training in the related fields of architecture, landscape planning, civil engineering, social science, public policy and political science. In Project/Thesis work, provision of analyzing any urban, rural or regional problems with major findings and recommendation concerning sustainable planning perspective is exposed for all the fellows.
At present the academic program is successfully running with 15 (Fifteen) teachers and 4 (Four) adjunct faculty who provide their best expertise level for the fellow student. Besides, department hire specialized and experienced personnel from professional field to teach the fellow students as guest teacher. The Department is persistent in its efforts to improve its research facilities to meet the growing technological challenges confronting the country.

## Vision

Vision of the department is to become a leading urban and regional planning department in worldwide with teaching and research facilities to contribute in sustainable urban and rural development.

**Aim of this program**

Urban and regional planning is a dynamic field that requires innovative solutions from committed and thoughtful individuals. Historically, it emerged out of the convergence of two concerns:
• The provision of urban infrastructure.
• The initiation of social reform.
Today, the underlying focus on community well-being continues, urban and regional planning has broadened to include the development, implementation, and evaluation of a wide range of policies. Specifically urban and regional planners, in both developing and developed countries, are concerned with:

• The use of land in the city, in the suburbs, and in rural areas, and particularly with the transition from one use to another.
• Potential adverse impacts of human activities on a limited physical environment and the possible mitigation of those impacts.
• The design of the city and the surrounding region so as to facilitate the activities in which people need and desire to engage.
• Settlement systems and the location of human activities in urban and regional space.
• Identification of social needs and the design and provision of services and facilities to meet those needs.
• The distribution of resources, benefits and costs among people.
• The anticipation of change and its impact on how people do and can live.
• Participation of citizens in planning processes which affect their future.
• The way that choices are made, decisions implemented and actions evaluated, and the means by which those processes can be improved in urban and regional areas.

**Our Identity**
We view planning as a professional and intellectual endeavor. We are strongly committed not only to the education of the next generation of planning professionals and leaders, but also to augmenting the profession through significant research accomplishments that are disseminated widely to academic and professional audiences. The Department’s faculty, students, and staff therefore engage in activities that simultaneously serve education, research, and public and professional engagement functions.

We emphasize the ecological, economic, social, and institutional aspects of urban and regional development and the theory and practice of planning processes. We teach and conduct research to improve understanding of human settlements and of planning situations and we focus on planning as the achievement of outcomes based on interrelated actions over time and space, not merely on individual policies or administrative decisions. Collaboration and close communication with a wide range of disciplines and professions is thus inherent in our approach. This collaboration is enhanced through faculty appointed in the department whose degrees are in architecture, economics, geography, history, law, political science, regional science, and zoology. We encourage faculty to pursue interdisciplinary research and to make scholarly contributions to both planning and fields closely allied with planning and we encourage and facilitate dual degree programs for students who wish professional qualifications in related fields.

We recognize planning for cities and regions as a process with a design component, in addition to ecological and human behavioral components. As a result, we seek to leverage our location in the College of Fine and Applied Arts to exploit innovative collaborative education, teaching and engagement opportunities with design-oriented disciplines, especially with the Department of Architecture.

We seek to understand human settlement and propose planning solutions at multiple spatial scales and locations—site, neighborhood, city, region, nation, and world. We therefore conduct research all over the world, and we seek a student body that is not just diverse in terms of gender, race and ethnicity, but also in terms of regional and national origin.

**Aspirations**
Our vision of our identity is based on a set of aspirations that guide our programs and influence the general direction of the Department.
• We are an intellectually exciting, creative, and productive community of students, scholars, and professionals. We engage in close interaction with related units, including not only Architecture, but also Agriculture and Consumer Economics, Civil Engineering, Economics, Education, Natural Resources and Environmental Sciences, Finance, Geography, Government and Public Affairs, Human and Community Development, Law, Psychology, Social Work, and Sociology.
• We maintain an active program in neighborhood and community empowerment through community engagement and other professional activities that integrate teaching, research, and service.
• We have a diverse, representative, student body, faculty, and staff interacting with and enhancing each other as individuals.
• We involve the frequent participation of practicing professionals in activities on campus.
• We offer active continuing education opportunities for professional and citizen planners.
• We foster the international exchange of planning ideas and experience through teaching, research, public service, and active roles in international organizations.
• Our programs and research have a strong environmental component, bringing environmental science results to bear on specific planning situations.

Bangladeshi graduated planners to make scope in the field of operations other than BIP, planning professionals are always encouraged to be affiliated by the societies in Earthquake Research, Disaster Management and Mitigation, Environment, Conservation, Rehabilitation, national and international professional bodies very closely related to Urban and Regional Planning.

**Migration to other profession**
Very frequently, planners with their bachelor degree are undertaking Masters’ Program in different field of Engineering and Development Planning. As the Bachelor of Urban and Regional Planning Degree program is designed with interdisciplinary attitude of acquiring knowledge in diverse field of learning and practicing, it is now planners’ choice to migrate, or to be in the same field of operation according to the market demand of working professionals.
Doors are always open to make Masters’ and Doctoral studies in Disaster and Environmental Engineering (CUET, BRAC), Disaster Management (Denmark, Norway, UK), Photogrammetry and Geoinformatics (Germany, USA), Geographical Information System (Sweden, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain), Physical Geography (Canada, USA, Australia), Human Settlements (Belgium, China, UK, Chili), Urban Design (UK), Regional Planning (Germany), Business Administration (USA, Canada, Australia), etc.

**Job hunting and Scholarships for higher studies**

From the experiences of last two decades, it is evident that Planners are working in Development Authority (RAJUK, CDA, KDA, RDA, etc), City Corporations (DCC, KCC, CCC, RCC, etc), Municipalities, different United Nations organizations (prominently in UNDP, WHO, UNHABITAT, UNHCR, etc), Donor organizations (GTZ-GIZ, OXFAM, DFID, DANIDA, SIDA, AusAID, UKAID, USAID, etc), implementing organizations (CARE, Caritas, ActionAID, CDMP, etc) and in the main stream of government BCS, Planning Commission, Magistracy, Police Department, etc. Therefore, being a planner by profession and affiliation, it reduces chance to be unemployed. Besides, comparatively planning graduates achieve more scholarship opportunities in Asia, Europe and Australia than other professional fields. Higher studies are supported by ADB, DAAD, VLIR-OUS, MEXT, ERASMUS-MUNDUS, Commonwealth and many other organizations.

## Mission

The mission of the Department is to address the steadily increasing needs in the field of urban and regional planning from local, national and international level of development. This 4 year program is innovative in its multi-disciplinary setup and arranges knowledge around emerging contemporary urban phenomenon, rather than only around purely academic framework.

## Message from the Head

The Department of Urban and Regional Planning at CUET was established in 2009 under the Faculty of Architecture and Planning. Currently the Department is offering the Bachelor in Urban and Regional Planning (B.URP) degree. Up to now ten batches of students are admitted whereas six batches have been graduated and serving in many governmental and Non-Governmental organizations with good reputation.

Besides the primary concern with human settlement development planning at the urban, rural and regional level; the Department introduces some courses on hilly region planning and development, water resources and drainage planning etc. based on the local needs. The department provides one of the best programs on urban and regional planning in Bangladesh. The activities of the Department focus on several aspects including physical, environmental, economic, political and institutional aspects. Teaching on planning at the Department also encompasses within urban and rural planning,   regional and local planning, socio-economic planning, transportation planning, resources allocation planning etc. The balanced curriculum as offered for the Bachelor in Urban and Regional Planning is rich in theoretical perspectives with required practical approaches.

The expertise of the faculties and the facilities in the laboratories are well equipped and able to provide up-to-date technological support to various public and private organizations in the country. The graduates from the department can pursue careers in different public and private agencies, consulting firms or in teaching and research outlets. Nevertheless, the department is persistent in its effort to improve its research facilities to meet the growing needs and to cope with the fast changing technological challenges.

## About

Department of Architecture has marked a progression in the history of Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology which has been established in 2009 under the Faculty of Architecture & Planning. The Department of Architecture is committed to advance architectural education through different programs and researches. ## Vision

To be a center of excellence in architectural education, research and innovation, fostering sustainable and context-responsive design solutions that shape the built environment for a better future.

## Mission

The **Architecture Department of CUET** is committed to providing quality education through a comprehensive and dynamic curriculum that equips students with the knowledge, creativity, and technical skills essential for architectural practice. We emphasize sustainable and contextual design, promoting environmentally responsible and socially relevant architecture that addresses both global and local challenges. Through interdisciplinary research, technological advancements, and innovation, we strive to contribute to the evolving fields of architecture and urban planning. Our mission also focuses on professional and ethical development, instilling strong values, leadership qualities, and a deep sense of responsibility towards society and the profession. Furthermore, we actively engage with industries, government, and communities to foster collaborations that contribute to the sustainable development of the built environment.

## Message from the Head

The Department of Architecture is founded on strong principles of multidisciplinary collaboration and respect for experimentation, rooted in social, cultural, and environmental values. We are trying to reflect in our innovative teaching, scholarly research, critical design inquiry, and synthetic practice. These principles will remain a strong reinforcement of our school, while supporting our incessant exploration of emerging theory and knowledge in design thinking, innovative materials and technologies, digital design and fabrication, and sustainability. Our undergraduate program covers fields of design and design theory, history of architecture and urbanism, building science and sustainability, structures and construction, social and cultural processes, environmental design in developing country like ours, digital design and virtual environments, urban design, and visual studies. We are interested in the entire life cycle of the building process, from conceptualization, through design and representation, craft and construction, and the performance of both constructed and virtual environments. We teach students to imagine, question, experiment, innovate, build, and reflect. Our curriculum is designed to foster independent thinking and to give students a balance of foundational knowledge and skills, with flexibility to follow their passions. We look forward to a busy and productive year of continued excellence. The Department of Architecture is closely linked with other departments, notably engineering. All of the Department's activities are accommodated on one site, including: design studio spaces, lecture and classrooms, workshop and IT facilities, research offices, staff offices and administration. The Department adopts a range of teaching methods and covers a wide range of topics from sustainable design to cultural studies.

text:
## About

The Department of Petroleum and Mining Engineering (PME) offers Bachelor of Science in Petroleum and Mining engineering which is one the top university level programs among the engineering universities in Bangladesh. This discipline is founded in March, 2010. 30 students are enrolled in this discipline every year. The department has a good number of quality faculties and has very well organized and enriched lab facilities.

The mission of the Department of Petroleum and Mining Engineering is to guide all efforts aiming to build, sustain, incorporate, convey and apply petroleum and mining engineering knowledge, and to augment the human resources of these disciplines and thus to help ensuring the nation an energy-secure future that balances environmental impact and affordable energy supply. The vision of the department is to stay put as the number one petroleum and mining engineering program in the country, so that its graduates are globally admired, respected and fit-for-purpose professionals within the industry.

To fulfill this mission, the PME department committed to pursue excellence in Well Logging and Formation Evaluation, Well Drilling and Completions, Reservoir Engineering, Production Engineering, Integrated Reservoir Characterization, Fit-for-purpose Reservoir Management Techniques, and Mining Engineering including Mine Surveying, Rock Mechanics, Mining Systems, Mine Planning and Design, Rock Blasting and Explosive Technology with balance environmental impact. To accelerate the journey of this department world distinguished petroleum software development company Petroleum Experts Ltd. has donated the equivalent of £2,584,803.70 to the University providing full package of Petroleum Experts' suite of programs (IPM suite). The department also got the generous contribution from the KAPPA Engineering and Fekete Associates getting the full suite of their petroleum engineering software.

Students of PME department gain practical experience and first-hand knowledge of many aspects of petroleum and mining engineering through close proximity to industry in the country. Oil and gas fields, coal and hard rock mines, their production sites, compressor stations, mineral processing industry, geological outcrops all provide through modern, well-equipped laboratories within the department and the University. Students are urged to gain field experience through field visit and internship in the industry. Besides studying, students of this department are encouraged to take part in extra-curricular activities. The CUET SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) student chapter has started its journey in 2017. This chapter organizes networking and knowledge sharing events that help the student to stay in touch with the petroleum world.

## Vision

To establish a state-of-the-art educational program in petroleum and mining engineering, so that its graduates are globally admired and fit-for-purpose professionals within the industry.

## Mission

M1: To guide all efforts aiming to build, sustain, incorporate, convey, and apply petroleum and mining engineering knowledge among its graduates.

M2: To augment the human resources of these disciplines and thus to help the nation with an energy-secured future that balances environmental impact and affordable energy supply.

M3: To serve as a regional center of excellence for undergraduate education, research, and technology concerning the safe and efficient utilization of subsurface natural resources.

M4: To enhance collaboration with foreign entities in order to exchange sustainable knowledge and deliver services to the society.

M5: To provide advisory services for solving national and global emerging problems in related discipline.

## Message from the Head

Welcome to Petroleum and Mining Engineering at the Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology. The Department of Petroleum and Mining Engineering (PME) offers Bachelor of Science in Petroleum and Mining engineering which is one the top university level programs among the engineering universities in Bangladesh.

The mission of the Department of Petroleum and Mining Engineering is to give undergraduate students a high-quality engineering education aiming to build, sustain, incorporate, convey and apply petroleum and mining engineering knowledge, and to augment the human resources of these disciplines and thus to help ensuring the nation an energy-secure future that balances environmental impact and affordable energy supply.

The department focuses on two major areas of research: petroleum engineering and mining engineering to contribute to the energy sector. All our faculty members are ready and willing to work in their research areas of expertise with students on individual projects. We make every effort to ensure that all our undergraduate students get a strong education with teaming and leadership skills, contribution in student activities, and the practical background of co-operation and internship experience. We believe that emphasizing these areas will put together our students well qualified to take leadership roles in the years to come.

The department of PME is committed to provide excellence in Reservoir Engineering, Production Engineering, Well Drilling and Completions, Mine Surveying, Rock Mechanics, Integrated Reservoir Characterization, Fit-for-purpose Reservoir Management Techniques, and Mining Engineering with balanced environmental impact. We have very well and organized lab facilities. Our syllabus and curriculum are comparable to that of renowned Petroleum and Mining University of the world. The syllabus is updated in a regular basis to keep pace with time and modern technologies. Our aim is to prepare our student with an international perspective that will ensure their organizational competitiveness.

title: Water Resources Engineering
text:
## About

Population growth and economic development continue to place increasing stress on global water resources, stresses that stem primarily from rising consumptive demands for limited supplies and increasing contaminant loads to natural waters. This growing population and need for clean water at everywhere demands specific professional on Water Resources Engineers to develop solutions that are environmentally sustainable, economically viable and socially acceptable. In view of that, the Department of Water Resources Engineering (WRE) has been established in CUET with the vision of producing the knowledgebase to tackle the challenges in a scientific and engineering way. Despite considerable advances in technology and engineering, managing and protecting water is still a challenge in particular to Bangladesh context. River erosion, deterioration of waterways are major concern for the development of river system in the country. In addition managing floods, droughts and climate change related disasters are becoming more challenging issues for water resources management and development. Proper utilization of water resources has become the fundamental element of the strategy to improve the quality of life in Bangladesh, contributing to sustainable development of the community and thereby reducing poverty and sufferings. Mainstreaming Water Resources Engineering knowledge in the core of Civil Engineering field is a time worthy demand for the society now-a-days. To satisfy this basic demand, the WRE Department of CUET offers Undergraduate Degree Programme to impart education towards an understanding of the complexity of water use and water resources engineering problems by offering a balanced curriculum, covering both engineering and management aspects of water resource development. Our aim is to teach students to acquire knowledge and hand on practice tool and techniques to come up with viable and sustainable solutions. Graduates from this department will be able to face the current challenges of securing water and effectively deal with spatial and temporal variability and uncertainty of water.

## Vision

The vision of the department is to be a leading Water Resources Engineering Department through quality education, research, and innovation.

## Mission

The mission of the department is to provide quality education to promote research and innovation in Water Resources Engineering to produce skilled, ethical, and committed graduates to play a leading role in the sustainable development of home and abroad.

#### **Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)**

- Provide students with a broad and thorough education so that the graduates should be well versed in several areas of Water Resources Engineering.
- Ability to identify, formulate, and solve a wide range of Water Resources Engineering problems using modern engineering tools and techniques that incorporate a broad range of considerations such as economic, environmental, ethical, social, and policy implications.
- Prepare graduates for continuing their studies at the graduate level.

#### **Program Outcomes (POs)**

- Ability to apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, and to formulate and solve Water Resources Engineering problems.
- Ability to design and perform experiments; analyze and interpret data.
- Ability to design water resources engineering system, component, process, facility.
- Ability to work and function in multi-disciplinary teams.
- Understanding of professional issues and practice ethics.
- Ability to effectively communicate.
- Ensure having broad education to understand the impact of Water Resources Engineering solutions in social and global impact.
- Ability to engage in life-long learning and professional development.
- Attain knowledge of contemporary issues.
- Ability to solve Water Resources Engineering problems using techniques, skills, and modern engineering tools necessary for engineering practice.
- Adequately learned basic concepts of business, management; understand and learn the importance of leadership in discussions and public policy.
- Ability to read, understand and interpret standards, codes, and manuals of engineering practice.

#### **Have proficiency in the following areas of Water Resources Engineering:**

- Coastal Engineering

title: Civil Engineering
text:
## About

The Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) is committed to excellence in undergraduate and postgraduate education and research across a broad spectrum of civil engineering disciplines. The department also emphasizes multidisciplinary areas related to the planning, design, and management of infrastructure and the built environment.

Civil engineering plays a vital role in improving public health, safety, and quality of life. The department contributes to societal well-being through education and research focused on sustainable solutions, including the provision of safe drinking water, efficient transportation systems, resilient housing, and the mitigation of natural and human-induced hazards.

The academic programs are designed to provide a strong foundation in fundamental principles while emphasizing practical applications. The curriculum integrates modern technologies, analytical tools, and advanced methodologies, enabling students to address real-world engineering challenges. The department also promotes the effective integration of engineering, planning, and management, with due consideration of environmental sustainability and the evolving socio-economic context of the country.

In addition to teaching and research, the department actively serves industry, public, and government sectors through consultancy, laboratory testing, structural analysis and design, product standardization, certification, and professional development activities.

Civil engineering is inherently multidisciplinary, combining technical expertise with a broader understanding of societal needs. The department prepares graduates to take leadership roles in infrastructure development and environmental management, equipping them with advanced knowledge, critical thinking abilities, and the professional skills required to meet the challenges of a rapidly developing society.

The department currently has 43 faculty members, including 17 with doctoral degrees, all of whom are actively engaged in teaching, research, and professional activities. In addition to their academic responsibilities, several faculty members also contribute to the administrative functions of the university.

## Vision

**The vision** of the Department is to be recognized as a leading civil engineering department nationally and globally through excellence in education, research, and innovation, producing competent graduates and contributing to sustainable and resilient infrastructure development.

## Mission

**Mission:**

- **M1: **To produce graduates who are capable, thoughtful, ethical citizens of the world.
- **M2:** To equip students with the knowledge, intellectual engagement, and professional skills they need to succeed.
- **M3: **To foster a commitment to lifelong learning, innovation, and excellence.
- **M4:** To provide high-quality and ethical teaching, research, capacity building, and community service
opportunities.

#### **Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)**

- **PEO-1 :** Knowledgeable and technically competent in civil engineering discipline in line with the industry requirement. (M2)
- **PEO-2 :** Effective in communication and demonstrate good leadership quality in an organization. (M1)
- **PEO-3 :** Capable of solving civil engineering problems innovatively, creatively and ethically in line with sustainable approach. (M4)
- **PEO-4 :** Able to demonstrate entrepreneurship skills and recognize the need for long-life learning for successful career advancement. (M3)

#### Program Outcomes (POs)

- **PO (a):** Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in K1 to K4 respectively to the solution of complex engineering problems.
- **PO (b):** Identify, formulate, research literature and analyse complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences and engineering sciences. (K1 to K4)
- **PO (c):** Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design systems, components or processes that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations. (K5)
- **PO (d): **Conduct investigations of complex problems using research-based knowledge (K8) and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of information to provide valid conclusions.
- **PO (e): **Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, to complex engineering problems, with an understanding of the limitations. (K6)
- **PO (f): **Apply reasoning informed by contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to professional engineering practice and solutions to complex engineering problems. (K7)
- **PO (g): **Understand and evaluate the sustainability and impact of professional engineering work in the solution of complex engineering problems in societal and environmental contexts. (K7)
- **PO (h): **Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of engineering practice. (K7)
- **PO (i):** Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams and in multi-disciplinary settings.
- **PO (j): **Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.
- **PO (k): **Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
- **PO (l): **Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

#### Knowledge Profile

- K1 : A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline
- K2 : Conceptually based mathematics, numerical analysis, statistics and the formal aspects of computer and information science to support analysis and modeling applicable to the discipline
- K3 : A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline
- K4 : Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline
- K5 : Knowledge that supports engineering design in a practice area
- K6 : Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline
- K7 : Comprehension of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline: ethics and the engineer’s professional responsibility to public safety; the impacts of engineering activity; economic, social, cultural, environmental and sustainability
- K8 : Engagement with selected knowledge in the research literature of the discipline

## Message from the Head

The Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) is committed to excellence in undergraduate and postgraduate education, as well as research across a broad range of civil engineering disciplines. The department also emphasizes multidisciplinary areas related to the planning, design, and management of infrastructure and the built environment.

As one of the leading departments of the university, it is supported by a team of highly qualified and dedicated faculty members who are actively engaged in teaching and research in diverse fields of civil engineering. The department continuously integrates emerging technologies and modern analytical tools into its academic and research activities to remain aligned with global advancements in the field.

Recognizing the dynamic nature of civil engineering, the department regularly updates its curriculum to reflect recent developments and industry needs. It is dedicated to providing high-quality and innovative learning opportunities that equip students with the fundamental knowledge, technical skills, and professional attitudes required for successful careers in civil engineering.

In addition to academic activities, the department actively contributes to industry, public, and government sectors through research publications, consultancy services, laboratory testing, structural analysis and design, product standardization, certification, and professional development programs.

The Department of Civil Engineering warmly welcomes students, researchers, and collaborators to be part of its academic and professional community.

## Laboratories

#### **Strength of Materials Laboratory**

The Strength of Materials Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports both teaching and research in structural engineering, solid mechanics, and construction materials. The laboratory is designed to equip students with practical knowledge and hands-on experience essential for the analysis and design of safe, efficient, and durable structures.

To meet the evolving demands of modern engineering practice, the laboratory facilitates learning in structural behavior, material properties, and advanced testing methodologies. It is integrated with the Engineering Materials Laboratory, and together they occupy approximately 5,000 square feet of floor space.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to conduct a wide range of experiments, including:

- Determination of general properties of concrete
- Tests for specific gravity, unit weight, moisture content, and water absorption of coarse and fine aggregates
- Fineness modulus (FM) of aggregates
- Tests on brick, mortar, and cement
- Compressive and tensile strength tests of cement mortar
- Stress–strain behavior and mechanical properties of materials
- Tension, shear, impact, and torsion tests on mild steel specimens
- Slender column tests and static bending tests
- Hardness tests of metals
- Helical spring tests

**Major Equipment**

The laboratory is equipped with modern instruments, including:

- Universal Testing Machine (UTM)
- Digital Universal Testing Machine
- Spring Testing Machine
- Hardness Testing Apparatus
- Compression (Crushing) Testing Machine
- Torsion Testing Machine
- Vibro Consistometer
- Concrete Core Cutter
- Cement Mortar Mixer
- Brick Cutter and Capping Apparatus

**Recent Developments**

To enhance research and teaching capabilities, several advanced instruments have been recently added, including a digital Universal Testing Machine, a concrete core cutter, a vibro consistometer, and a cement mortar mixer.

#### **Geotechnical Engineering Laboratory**

The Geotechnical Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in soil mechanics, foundation engineering, and engineering geology. The laboratory plays a vital role in developing an understanding of the behavior of soils and rocks, and their application in the design and construction of civil engineering infrastructure, resource development, and hazard mitigation.

The laboratory is closely aligned with core courses such as soil mechanics, subsurface exploration and testing, foundation engineering, earth structures, and engineering geology.

Spanning approximately 2,100 square feet, the laboratory is equipped with modern facilities to support both undergraduate instruction and postgraduate research. It provides students with hands-on experience in determining the physical and mechanical properties of soils through a wide range of standard laboratory and field tests.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to perform:

- Field identification tests of soils
- Specific gravity tests
- Atterberg limits (liquid limit, plastic limit, shrinkage limit)
- Grain size analysis (sieve and hydrometer methods)
- Relative density tests
- Field density tests
- Permeability tests
- Compaction tests
- Unconfined compression tests
- Direct shear tests
- Consolidation tests

**Major Equipment**

Key equipment available in the laboratory includes:

- Consolidation Testing Machine
- CBR Compaction Machine
- Direct Shear Test Machine
- Triaxial Testing Apparatus
- Unconfined Compression Testing Machine
- Electric Soil Mixer
- Sample Extractor/Injector
- Hydrometer Jar Bath
- Water Bath

#### **Environmental Engineering Laboratory**

The Environmental Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in water and wastewater engineering, environmental quality management, and pollution control. The laboratory plays a vital role in addressing contemporary environmental challenges, including water treatment, contaminant transport, and sustainable water resources management.

The laboratory is aligned with key areas such as physical, chemical, and biological treatment processes, environmental monitoring, and modeling of pollutant transport in natural and engineered systems.

Spanning approximately 2,200 square feet, the laboratory is equipped with modern instrumentation to support both undergraduate instruction and postgraduate research. It provides hands-on experience in the analysis and design of water supply and wastewater treatment systems.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to perform a wide range of environmental analyses, including:

- Physical, chemical, and bacteriological analysis of water and wastewater
- pH, Dissolved Oxygen (DO), Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), and Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) tests
- Determination of nitrogen, hardness, alkalinity, and conductivity
- Microbiological (bacteriological) analysis
- Design and analysis of water supply and wastewater treatment systems

**Major Equipment**

The laboratory is equipped with advanced and standard instruments, including:

- Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer (AAS)
- Total Organic Carbon (TOC) Analyzer
- Research Microscopes
- pH Meter
- DO Meter
- BOD Incubator
- COD Digester
- Conductivity Meter

**Facilities for Teaching and Research**

The laboratory includes functional units and setups for water and wastewater treatment processes, enabling practical demonstration and research on treatment technologies and system performance.

#### **Transportation Engineering Laboratory**

The Transportation Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in transportation planning, traffic engineering, and pavement design. The laboratory provides essential knowledge and practical skills required for the planning, design, and implementation of transportation infrastructure systems.

The laboratory is aligned with coursework in transportation engineering, covering areas such as transportation planning and economics, traffic analysis, and the design of highways and other transportation facilities.

It enables students to gain hands-on experience in the design and evaluation of both bituminous and concrete pavements. The laboratory also facilitates testing of subgrade, sub-base, and base course materials, as well as bituminous mix design and roadway capacity analysis.

**Testing Facilities**

The laboratory is equipped to perform:

- Tests on subgrade, sub-base, and base materials
- Bituminous mix design and analysis
- Pavement material characterization
- Roadway capacity and traffic studies
- Testing of bituminous binders and asphalt mixtures

**Major Equipment**

Key equipment available in the laboratory includes:

- Penetration Testing Apparatus
- Los Angeles Abrasion Testing Machine
- Aggregate Impact Testing Machine
- California Bearing Ratio (CBR) Testing Apparatus
- Bitumen Testing Equipment
- Ovens for material preparation and testing

#### **Hydraulic Engineering Laboratory**

The Hydraulic Engineering Laboratory of the Department of Civil Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET) supports teaching and research in fluid mechanics, open channel flow, and hydraulic engineering. The laboratory plays a key role in developing practical understanding of the behavior of water in natural and engineered systems, as well as in the planning, design, operation, and maintenance of hydraulic structures.

Spanning approximately 2,400 square feet, the laboratory is equipped to address multidisciplinary aspects of hydraulic engineering, including river engineering, sediment transport, and water resources systems.

A major section of the laboratory is dedicated to experimental studies on open channel flow, sediment transport, wave motion, and physical modeling of rivers, estuaries, and hydraulic structures.

**Testing and Experimental Facilities**

The laboratory supports experiments and demonstrations in:

- Open channel flow and flow measurement
- Sediment transport and river behavior
- Wave motion and hydraulic phenomena
- Fluid properties and flow characteristics
- Hydraulic structures and energy conversion systems

Key equipment available in the laboratory includes:

- Surface Tension Apparatus
- Jet Impact Apparatus

- Pelton Wheel (Impulse Turbine) Models

title: Biomedical Engineering
text:
## About

There is an endless demand in modern healthcare for technologies to improve the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of health problems. To meet this demand, the Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET) has a strong focus on health in its research and education programs and has a department devoted entirely to this socially vital area: Biomedical Engineering.

Biomedical engineering is the application of the principles and problem-solving techniques of engineering to biology and medicine. This is evident throughout healthcare, from diagnosis and analysis to treatment and recovery, and has entered the public conscience through the proliferation of implantable medical devices, such as pacemakers and artificial hips, to more futuristic technologies such as stem cell engineering and the 3-D printing of biological organs.

Biomedical engineers combine engineering approaches and principles with a rigorous knowledge of the biological and health sciences, working toward the embracive goal of improving human health. Career paths in biomedical engineering tend to be driven by the interests of the individual: the huge breadth of the field allows biomedical engineers to develop specialties in an area that interests them, be it biomaterials, neuromodulation devices, orthopedic repair, or even stem cell engineering. Biomedical engineers often combine an aptitude for problem-solving and technical know-how with focused study in medicine, healthcare, and helping others. It is this hybridization that has led to so much innovation—and so much opportunity—in biomedical engineering.

From the outset, the curriculum of our education programs integrates the natural sciences and engineering disciplines with biology and pathophysiology. It is designed to meld seamlessly with the research in our department.

## Vision

Our vision is to be the premier biomedical engineering platform in the world, based on the excellence of our people, our innovative multidisciplinary and enabling research, and our discovery-centered educational programs. We strive to pioneer the transfer of biomedical engineering research into applications that will advance and improve health care throughout Bangladesh and the world.

## Mission

The mission of the Department of Biomedical Engineering is to pursue excellence in biomedical engineering education, research, and innovation, creating and imparting knowledge for improving society, human health, and health care.

## Message from the Head

As the head of Department of Biomedical Engineering at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), it’s my great pleasure that I welcome you to our university and congratulate you for being admitted in this department. We are determined to build up world class Biomedical Engineers and sincere, responsible persons from the enrolled brilliant students.

Biomedical engineering is a dynamic and exciting area that provides excellent career opportunities in various sectors of the society. It is a discipline that integrates engineering principles and the study of the life sciences and medicine. Students in biomedical engineering develop engineering strategies to effectively solve challenging problems in medicine and biology. The Biomedical Engineering Department has been started since 2 April, 2019 under the faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering.

We are committed to give our students an environment where they develop critical thinking and problem solving skills as they advance through this program. In addition to classroom teaching, the students are guided and motivated to practically implement the principles learnt in classrooms through  implementation in the laboratories which helps students to gain confidence and become skilled engineering professionals.

This bachelor degree program is designed with courses in the foundation of electrical engineering, biology, computer science engineering, mechanical engineering, material science and engineering, tissue engineering, and the combination of these. The supporting courses outside Biomedical Engineering consist of a strong background in mathematics, physical sciences, chemistry and humanities.

Although young, our sense of enthusiasm about what to do, and dedication to lead Biomedical Engineering to new heights is indeed strong. We pride ourselves on providing a supportive and friendly environment for our students.

Have a nice stay with us and please try to achieve the best.

### **Power Electronics Laboratory**

**What is Power Electronics?**
Power Electronics is a technology to convert one or more properties of electric power, such as voltage, current, frequency, phase angle, number of phases, and waveforms, by using power semiconductor devices and/or circuits. It is a unified research area combining power engineering (electric machines, electric power systems), electronics engineering (semiconductor devices, circuits), and control engineering fields.

Currently, Power Electronics is widely applied in electric power systems such as power generation and transmission systems, industrial systems such as electric motors, fans, pumps, blowers, power supplies for information and communication systems, factory automation, transportation systems such as electric trains, pure and hybrid electric vehicles, home appliances, and more.

## About

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) was established in 1998 with the capacity of 60 students per session with a vision to produce skilled computer professionals for the betterment of the world and to nourish the technology.  Currently, the number of undergraduate student intake is 130 per academic session (two sections of 65 students each).

From the year 2011, the department has launched the post-graduate programs which include M. Sc. Engineering and M. Engineering. The department has started the PhD program from the year 2015. The faculty members are devotedly doing research works with their under graduate and post- graduate students. Their research efforts contribute around a good number of publications every year in different national and international conferences and journals. The department publishes a peer reviewed research journal “Computer Science and Engineering Research Journal” every year as well.

The Department of CSE is providing quality education with its competent faculty and well equipped modern laboratories. Moreover, the teacher-student relationship is especially commendable. Proper learning environment best fosters the competency of the students.

The department of CSE regularly arranges co-curricular activities such as workshops/seminars, training, and practical demos. The student organization of the department, namely CUET Computer Club is also active in organizing co-curricular and extra-curricular activities. It organizes programming contests regularly through to prepare the students for the ACM collegiate and other competitive programming contests

The vision of this department is to become a leading computer science and engineering department in home and abroad with the state-of-the-art teaching and research facilities in order to foster the technological, economic, and social enrichment of the nation and the world and establish itself as a center of excellence at the national and international level.

On behalf of the faculty members, staffs, and students of Department of Computer Science & Engineering of Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET), I welcome you all to this official website. text:
## About

Today, we are at the peak of the information technology age, and communication engineering plays a vital role in today's rapidly changing world. In this prospect, CUET has launched Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (ETE) in the year 2012. The vision of this department is to make great contribution by producing efficient and resourceful engineers with research and development capabilities.

The ETE Department has well qualified and experienced faculty members with areas of specialization that include Embedded Systems, Applied Electronics and VLSI design. The department has taken step to collect technologically advanced equipment and to build enriched laboratories. Students will be given vast amount of practical exposure through the use of innovative methodologies in the design and development of electronics, which is the backbone for all engineering disciplines.

The Department of ETE offers a comprehensive range of rigorous, innovative programs .The undergraduate curriculum of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering: is designed to give students a sound knowledge of Engineering fundamentals, strong physical sciences background and adequate practical training so that they will be ready to quickly achieve competence in treating current technical problems as well as those that will come with the rapidly changing technologies of the year-to-come. The Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering program prepares students for careers in such areas of electronics, computer, communication etc.

The aim of the undergraduate program of the Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (ETE) is to provide the students with a technical and engineering background and scientific research capabilities in the design and development and production of electronic devices, circuits and systems used in a wide spectrum of applications ranging from home appliances to the most sophisticated satellite communications.

## Vision

The Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology has been established to advance, maintain and disseminate knowledge at the internal levels.

The modern world increasingly values the results of intellectual endeavor. If Bangladesh is to prosper, educational institutes must play the central role in higher learning, research and teaching to increase her intellectual pursuit. In this context, the CUET has set a two-fold vision.

Firstly, to send out graduates with trained and educated minds, to serve as a source of intellectual potentiality.

Secondly, to be a premier research Institute, internationally known for its excellence and contributions to knowledge, teaching and graduates.

## Mission

- To foster and promote a distinctive educational institute identity and spirit.
- To purpose excellence in research that will contribute to knowledge and learning.
- To purpose excellence in curriculum, teaching and to a standard befitting an international research institute.
- To develop and maximize the effectiveness of all staff.
- To attract students with thirst of knowledge. to encourage and support them in their progress.
- To maintain the principle of academic freedom and to maintain the institutional autonomy.
- To contribute to the betterment of society and be responsive to its needs.
- To provide high quality, responsive and cost effective support service for research, learning and teaching.

## Message from the Head

We are living in the era of electronics and communication. The 5th generation industrial revolution stands on electronics and communication systems. To run with the next generation demands, Department of Electronics and Telecommunication  Engineering (ETE) takes initiative to produces world class engineers in the field of electronics and communication. As Head of the department of ETE at Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology (CUET), its my great pleasure that we do welcome you to our university and congratulate you for being admitted in this department. Our department is rather young but we are determined to build up world-class engineers and sincere, outspoken, tenacious and responsible persons from the enrolled brilliant students.

Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering is a dynamic and exciting arena of pedagogy that provides excellent career opportunities in various sectors of the society. Our aim is to educate the brilliant youth towards world-class education and to enable them to contribute to the development of our society by developing critical thinking and problem-solving skills as they advance through this program. The responsibilities and dedications or our teachers lead the ETE Department towards an outstanding learning environment, where the state-of-the-an laboratories, libraries, access to knowledge resources: abundance of computers. extracurricular activities and most importantly the personal care all are present.

This department is committed to the study and research of theoretical as well as applied problems. Teachers and students of the department work in solving problems in the fields of electrical engineering, principles, designs and applications analog and digital electronics, signal and image processing, multimedia communications and networking, biomedical engineering, microwave engineering, antenna analysis and design, optical fiber communication, broadband mobile cellular communications, VLSI and nano technology, solid-state devices, embedded systems. internet of thinks (loT) and so on. The supporting courses outside electronics and telecommunication engineering consist of a strong background in mathematics, physical sciences, social sciences, ethical values, management and humanities.

Albeit we are young in your journey, the quality, confidence, enthusiasm, and dedication we offer to lead Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering to new heights is indeed robust. Three batches are completed their journey from the department in time and do work in the country and aboard with name and fame. We endeavor our level best to provide a supportive and friendly atmosphere for our students.

Have a nice campus life with us and please try to achieve the best.

## Laboratories

To develop practical skills necessary for study and research, the ETE department has well-equipped and modern laboratories enriched with advanced training modules and equipment. Through experimentation, research, and exploration in the following laboratories of the ETE department, students can enrich their knowledge.

### Electronic Device & Circuit Laboratory

In order to gain fundamental and practical knowledge of electronics engineering, this well-equipped laboratory is used, which is enriched with modern electronic instruments and devices. This laboratory also serves students for implementing their projects and thesis in different terms.

The laboratory is well-equipped with:

- Ammeter
- Voltmeter
- Multimeter
- Oscilloscope (Analog and Digital)
- AC & DC Power Supply Unit and Variable AC Source
- Function Generator
- LCR Meter
- Other relevant components and semiconductor devices extensively used in electronics

### Antenna & Microwave Engineering Laboratory

One of the major sectors of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering is Antenna & Microwave Engineering. This laboratory provides students with all modern, necessary training kits and software for conducting their practical courses and advanced research in this field. This lab facilitates students with the following:

- Wave and Antenna Training System (WATS-2002)
- Microwave Communication Trainer (MW-2000)
- Microwave Signal Generation, Modulation, Transmission, Reception Trainer (ED-3000)
- ADS Software
- 9 GHz Vector Network Analyzer

### Simulation Laboratory

In this laboratory, students can perform computer programming and numerical analysis lab, signals and systems lab, digital signal processing lab, multimedia communication lab, neural and fuzzy systems lab in C, C++, MATLAB, and Python to learn about different types of signal generation, manipulation of audio & video signals, spectral analysis, filter response, computer programming, etc. Besides, design and simulation of different logic circuits in the field of VLSI is done in this laboratory by Cadence Virtuoso Software. In internet programming, students learn about HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and create databases for website development.

### Communication System Laboratory

Communication, the core of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, is one that requires hands-on experience and practical demonstrations of systems in communication. Our Communication System Laboratory enables students to conduct their analog and digital communication lab, telecommunication networks, and switching lab with all the latest communication trainers. The lab provides the following trainers:

- Mobile Telecom Trainer
- Telecommunication Switching Trainer
- EPABX Trainer
- GSM Trainer
- GPS Trainer
- Analog Communication Trainer
- Digital Communication Trainer

### Computer Communications & Network Laboratory

To visualize the networking environments of communication systems, this well-resourced laboratory is equipped with LAN trainer, different types of networking devices, Cisco Packet Tracer, and Network Analyzer software, which are used to simulate and analyze network topologies, and configure Cisco routers and switches.

### Digital & Microprocessor Laboratory

In the Digital & Microprocessor Laboratory, students conduct experiments on digital logic circuits and also learn assembly language programming, generate hex code, and input it to the 8086 microprocessor kit. Our Digital & Microprocessor Laboratory provides the following setup:

- Digital Electronics Trainer Board
- Different types of Logic ICs
- MIDAS-8086 Microprocessor
- Microcontroller
- FPGA Trainer

### Optical Fiber Communication Laboratory

Optical Fiber Communication has revolutionized the telecommunications industry with its enormous advantages. Our Optical Fiber Communication Laboratory is enriched with the latest trainers like fiber optic analog and digital communication trainers, modulation and demodulation trainers, co-axial transmission line trainers, etc. to facilitate students' practical understanding.

### Biomedical Instrumentation Laboratory

The Biomedical Instrumentation Laboratory is for conducting experiments in the field of biomedical engineering. This laboratory includes a transducer trainer to observe several biomedical sensors' performance, ECG, EEG, EMG trainers to visualize their characteristics, and a Digital Electrocardiograph module to monitor real-time ECG.

Students in the first year have to undertake laboratory/sessional classes in Physics, Chemistry, and Electrical Circuit Laboratory. Initially, students will make use of all the laboratory facilities from the Department of EEE and the Department of CSE.

## চুয়েটে জমকালো আয়োজনে ২৪তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উদযাপিত

### **বৈশ্বিক পরিবর্তনের সাথে খাপ-খাওয়াতে না পারলে পিছিয়ে পড়বোঃ অর্থমন্ত্রী**

গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় অর্থ এবং পরিকল্পনা মন্ত্রী জনাব আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী, এমপি মহোদয় বলেছেন, সারাবিশ্বে অনেক ধরনের পরিবর্তন হচ্ছে। এ পরিবর্তনের সাথে খাপ-খাওয়াতে হবে। নয়তো বিশ্ব আমাদের অনেক আগে চলে যাবে, আমরা পেছনে পড়ে থাকবো। তিনি আরো বলেন, আমাদের ছেলেমেয়েদের অনেক মেধা আছে। আমাদের অনেক ভালো গবেষকও আছেন। সরকার গবেষণার উপর এবার অধিকতর গুরুত্ব দিয়েছে। এখন উদ্ভাবন নিয়ে আমাদের আরো বেশি চিন্তা করতে হবে। বর্তমান সরকার উদ্ভাবন নিয়ে অনেক কাজ শুরু করেছে। আমাদের মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী উদ্ভাবনীমূলক কাজ অনেক পছন্দ করেন। আমাদের উদ্ভাবনী শক্তি যাদের আছে, তাদের খুঁজে বের করতে হবে। আমি মনে করি চট্টগ্রাম হবে বাংলাদেশের লজিস্টিক হাব। এখানে চুয়েটও গুরুত্বপূণ ভূমিকা রাখতে পারে। চুয়েট এর সক্ষমতা উত্তরোত্তর বৃদ্ধি পাক এই কামনা করি।

আজ ০১ সেপ্টেম্বর (মঙ্গলবার) ২০২৬ খ্রি. চুয়েটের কেন্দ্রীয় অডিটোরিয়ামে চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (চুয়েট)-এর ২৪তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবসের আলোচনা সভায় প্রধান অতিথির বক্তব্যে তিনি এসব কথা বলেন। এতে গেস্ট অব অনার ছিলেন চট্টগ্রাম—৬ (রাউজান) আসনের মাননীয় সংসদ সদস্য জনাব গিয়াসউদ্দিন কাদের চৌধুরী মহোদয় এবং ইউনিভার্সিটি টেকনোলজি পেট্রোনাস (UTP) মালয়েশিয়ার পেট্রোলিয়াম ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগের চেয়ারম্যান আইআর. ড. মোহাম্মদ আজুয়ান বিন মাওনসার। সভায় সভাপতিত্ব করেন চুয়েটের মাননীয় ভাইস—চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম।

গেস্ট অব অনার মাননীয় সংসদ সদস্য জনাব গিয়াসউদ্দিন কাদের চৌধুরী বলেন, চুয়েট হলো দেশের একটি উজ্জ্বল প্রদীপ। এই প্রদীপ আলোকিত করতে পারে সারাদেশকে। আমরা যদি এই প্রদীপকে মূল্যয়ান করি, দেখভাল করি তাহলে এই প্রদীপের আলো সকলকে আলোকিত করবে।

ইউনিভার্সিটি টেকনোলজি পেট্রোনাস (UTP) মালয়েশিয়ার পেট্রোলিয়াম ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগের চেয়ারম্যান আইআর. ড. মোহাম্মদ আজুয়ান বিন মাওনসার বলেন, আমি চুয়েট এর অগ্রযাত্রা দেখে আশান্বিত। মালয়েশিয়ার বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়গুলোর সাথে চুয়েট এর সমঝোতা স্মারক হতে পারে। আমরা একসাথে কাজ করে শিক্ষা—গবেষণাকে অনেকদূর এগিয়ে নিতে পারি।

সভাপতির বক্তব্যে চুয়েটের মাননীয় ভাইস—চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম বলেন, বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের র‍্যাংকিং উন্নয়ন করে কমপক্ষে এশিয়া মানে নিয়ে যেতে চাই। আমি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে বিশ্বমানের শিক্ষা—গবেষণা নিশ্চিত করতে চাই। আশার কথা এই যে, আমরা সব উদ্যোগে বর্তমান সরকারসহ সকলের সহযোগিতা ও সমর্থন পাচ্ছি।

সভায় বিশেষ অতিথি ছিলেন চট্টগ্রাম—২ (ফটিকছড়ি) আসনের মাননীয় সংসদ সদস্য জনাব সরওয়ার আলমগীর, তড়িৎ ও কম্পিউটার প্রকৌশল অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. কাজী দেলোয়ার হোসেন, পুর ও পরিবেশ কৌশল অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. সুদীপ কুমার পাল, বিজ্ঞান ও প্রযুক্তি অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ আবু কাউছার, মেকানিক্যাল অ্যান্ড ম্যানুফ্যাকচারিং অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ মিজানুর রহমান, স্থাপত্য ও পরিকল্পনা অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ রাশিদুল হাসান। সভায় আমন্ত্রিত অতিথি ছিলেন চুয়েটের সাবেক ভাইস—চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ মোজাম্মেল হক। এতে স্বাগত বক্তব্য রাখেন রেজিস্ট্রার (অতিরিক্ত দায়িত্ব) অধ্যাপক ড. শেখ মোহাম্মদ হুমায়ুন কবির। সভায় শিক্ষক সমিতির পক্ষে বক্তব্য রাখেন শিক্ষক সমিতির সভাপতি অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ আহসান উল্লাহ, কর্মকর্তা সমিতির পক্ষে বক্তব্য রাখেন কর্মকর্তা সমিতির সাধারণ সম্পাদক প্রকৌশলী মোঃ মকবুল হোসেন, চুয়েট স্টাফ এসোসিয়েশনের পক্ষে বক্তব্য রাখেন স্টাফ এসোসিয়েশনের সভাপতি জনাব মোহাম্মদ জামাল উদ্দীন, ছাত্রদের পক্ষে হতে বক্তব্য রাখেন পুরকৌশল বিভাগের ২২ ব্যাচের ছাত্র ফাইয়াজ মুহাম্মদ কৌশিক, ছাত্রীদের পক্ষে বক্তব্য রাখেন পুরকৌশল বিভাগের ২২ ব্যাচের ছাত্রী ফাহিম নুজহাত জাহিন। অনুষ্ঠান সঞ্চালনা করেন চুয়েটের ইলেকট্রিক্যাল অ্যান্ড ইলেকট্রনিক ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগ (ইইই) বিভাগের অধ্যাপক ড. মেহেদী হাসান চৌধুরী, উপ—পরিচালক (জনসংযোগ) জনাব মোহাম্মদ ফজলুর রহমান এবং ইলেকট্রিক্যাল অ্যান্ড ইলেকট্রনিক ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগ (ইইই) বিভাগের প্রভাষক জনাব আজমল আহমেদ। অনুষ্ঠানের শুরুতে চুয়েটের উপর একটি প্রামাণ্যচিত্র প্রদর্শন করা হয়। এরপর পবিত্র কোরআন তেলাওয়াত করেন চুয়েটের কেন্দ্রীয় মসজিদের সিনিয়র পেশ ইমাম হাফেজ মাওলানা ক্বারী নুরুল্লাহ।

এর আগে, সকালে জাতীয় পতাকা ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পতাকা উত্তোলন এবং জাতীয় সংগীত পরিবেশন করা হয়। পরে বেলুন ও শান্তির প্রতীক পায়রা উড়িয়ে দিনব্যাপী অনুষ্ঠানমালার উদ্বোধন করেন গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় অর্থ এবং পরিকল্পনা মন্ত্রী জনাব আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী এমপি মহোদয়। এরপর আলহাজ্ব জসিম উদ্দিন ফাউন্ডেশন থেকে উপহার হিসেবে প্রাপ্ত ৬ টি বাস উদ্বোধন করা হয়। জসিম উদ্দিন ফাউন্ডেশন কর্তৃক চুয়েটকে উপহার হিসেবে প্রদত্ত বাসগুলোর চাবি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে হস্তান্তর করেন আলহাজ্ব জসিম উদ্দিন ফাউন্ডেশনের সম্মানিত চেয়ারম্যান জনাব মোহাম্মদ জসিম উদ্দিন। অতঃপর চুয়েটের গোল চত্বরে চট্টগ্রাম ওয়াসা কর্তৃক প্রদত্ত পানি সংযোগ লাইনের ভিত্তিপ্রস্তর উদ্বোধন করেন গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় অর্থ ও পরিকল্পনামন্ত্রী জনাব আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী এমপি। এ সময় গোল চত্বরে স্মারক বৃক্ষরোপণ কর্মসূচি অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। এরপর তিনি চুয়েটের ক্লাব ফেস্ট এর বিভিন্ন স্টল এবং টিম ব্লিটজারের তৈরী গো—কার্ট পরিদর্শন করেন।
উক্ত অনুষ্ঠানমালার পর ২৪তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উপলক্ষ্যে আনন্দ র‌্যালি রেব করা হয়। র‌্যালিতে রঙ—বেরঙের প্ল্যাকার্ড ও ফ্যাস্টুন সহকারে অতিথিবৃন্দ, চুয়েটের শিক্ষক, কর্মকর্তা, কর্মচারী ও ছাত্র—ছাত্রীগণ অংশগ্রহণ করেন।  অন্যান্য কর্মসূচির মধ্যে ছিল রক্তদান কর্মসূচি, পরে কর্মকর্তা বনাম কর্মচারী ও শিক্ষক বনাম ছাত্র প্রীতি ফুটবল ম্যাচ, পুরষ্কার বিতরণ, সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠান ইত্যাদি।

## চুয়েটে সিএসই বিভাগের কর্মশালা অনুষ্ঠিত

### **মানুষের উদ্ভাবনী চিন্তা ভাবনাকে দ্রুত কাজে লাগাতে পারে সিএসই গ্রাজুয়েটরাঃ চুয়েট ভিসি**

চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (চুয়েট)—এর মাননীয় ভাইস—চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম বলেছেন, মানুষের উদ্ভাবনী চিন্তা ভাবনাকে দ্রুত সময়ে কাজে লাগাতে পারে সিএসই গ্রাজুয়েটরা। সিএসই বিভাগ অত্যন্ত স্মার্ট ও সম্ভাবনাময় বিভাগ। যেকোন সমস্যা বা সেবা সহজীকরণে সিএসই গ্রাজুয়েটরা ভালো ভূমিকা রাখতে পারে এবং সমস্যা সমাধান করে তা দ্রুত বাস্তবে প্রয়োগ করে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পাশাপাশি দেশেরও কল্যাণে কাজে লাগাতে হবে।
আজ ৩০ আগস্ট (রবিবার) ২০২৬ খ্রিঃ চুয়েটের কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স অ্যান্ড ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং (সিএসই) বিভাগ কতৃর্ক আয়োজিত "Preparing Self-Assessment Report of the CSE Program for BAETE Accreditation " শীর্ষক কর্মশালায় প্রধান অতিথির বক্তব্যে তিনি এসব কথা বলেন। এতে বিশেষ অতিথি ছিলেন চুয়েটের তড়িৎ ও কম্পিউটার প্রকৌশল অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. কাজী দেলোয়ার হোসেন এবং ইনস্টিটিউশনাল কোয়ালিটি অ্যাসিউরেন্স সেল (আইকিউএসি) এর পরিচালক অধ্যাপক ড. মো. আব্দুর রহমান ভুঁইয়া। কর্মশালায় রিসোর্স পার্সন ছিলেন নর্থ সাউথ ইউনিভার্সিটির ইলেক্ট্রিক্যাল অ্যান্ড কম্পিউটার ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগের অধ্যাপক ড. সালেকুল ইসলাম। এতে স্বাগত বক্তব্য রাখেন চুয়েটের সিএসই বিভাগের অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ সামসুল আরেফিন। এতে সভাপতিত্ব করেন কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স অ্যান্ড ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগ এর বিভাগীয় প্রধান অধ্যাপক ড. প্রণব কুমার ধর। কর্মশালা সঞ্চালনা করেন সিএসই বিভাগের প্রভাষক জনাব সাইমুম হোসাইন সোহান।

title: The Honorable Finance Minister is coming to CUET on the occasion of the 24th University Day.
text:
### ** ০১লা সেপ্টেম্বর ২৪তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উপলক্ষে  চুয়েটে আসছেন মাননীয় অর্থমন্ত্রী।**

চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (চুয়েট)—এ আগামী ৩১ আগস্ট থেকে ১ সেপ্টেম্বর ২০২৬ খ্রিঃ উদযাপিত হতে যাচ্ছে ২৪ তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস। এ উপলক্ষে আগামী ০১ সেপ্টেম্বর (মঙ্গলবার), ২০২৬ খ্রিঃ সকাল ১১.১৫ ঘটিকায় চুয়েটের কেন্দ্রীয় অডিটোরিয়ামে আলোচনা সভায় প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে থাকবেন অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয় এবং পরিকল্পনা মন্ত্রণালয় এর মাননীয় মন্ত্রী জনাব আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী এমপি মহোদয়। এতে গেস্ট অব অনার হিসেবে থাকবেন চট্টগ্রাম—৬ (রাউজান) আসনের মাননীয় সংসদ সদস্য জনাব গিয়াসউদ্দিন কাদের চৌধুরী মহোদয়। সভায় সভাপতিত্ব করবেন চুয়েটের মাননীয় ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম মহোদয়। সভায় বিশেষ অতিথি হিসেবে থাকবেন ইউনিভার্সিটি টেকনোলজি পেট্রোনাস (UTP) মালয়েশিয়ার পেট্রোলিয়াম ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগের চেয়ারম্যান আইআর. ড. মোহাম্মদ আজুয়ান বিন মাওনসার, চুয়েটের তড়িৎ ও কম্পিউটার প্রকৌশল অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. কাজী দেলোয়ার হোসেন, পুর ও পরিবেশ কৌশল অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. আসিফুল হক, বিজ্ঞান ও প্রযুক্তি অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ আবু কাউছার, মেকানিক্যাল অ্যান্ড ম্যানুফ্যাকচারিং অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ মিজানুর রহমান, স্থাপত্য ও পরিকল্পনা অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ রাশিদুল হাসান, রেজিস্ট্রার (অতিরিক্ত দায়িত্ব) অধ্যাপক ড. শেখ মোহাম্মদ হুমায়ুন কবির এবং ছাত্রকল্যাণ অধিদপ্তর এর পরিচালক অধ্যাপক ড. মোঃ সাইফুল ইসলাম।

২৪ তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উদযাপনের লক্ষ্যে ২ দিনব্যাপী অনুষ্ঠানের আয়োজন করা হচ্ছে। এতে ১ম দিন ৩১ আগস্ট, ২০২৬ খ্রিঃ (সোমবার) ক্লাব ফেস্ট ও একাডেমিক কাউন্সিল কক্ষে জ্বালানি বিষয়ক লেকচার এর আয়োজন করা হয়েছে। এতে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে উপস্থিত থাকার সদয় সম্মতি জ্ঞাপন করেছেন চট্টগ্রাম—৮ (বোয়ালখালী—চান্দগাঁও—পাঁচলাইশ) আসনের মাননীয় সংসদ সদস্য জনাব এরশাদ উল্লাহ মহোদয়। উক্ত লেকচারে রিসোর্স পার্সন হিসেবে হিসেবে থাকবেন মালয়েশিয়ার ইউনিভার্সিটি টেকনোলজি পেট্রোনাস (UTP) এর পেট্রোলিয়াম ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগের চেয়ারম্যান ড. মোহাম্মদ আজুয়ান বিন মাওনসার। এতে জ্বালানি বিষয় সংশ্লিষ্ট প্রায় ২৫০ জন শিক্ষক, গবেষক, প্রফেশনাল ও উদ্যোক্তা অংশগ্রহণ করবেন বলে আশা করা যাচ্ছে।

আজ ৩০ আগস্ট (রবিবার) ২০২৬ খ্রি. দুপুর ০১.০০ ঘটিকায় চুয়েটের একাডেমিক কাউন্সিল কক্ষে ২৪তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উপলক্ষে আয়োজিত সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে বিভিন্ন তথ্য তুলে ধরা হয়। এসময় উপস্তিত ছিলেন চুয়েটের মাননীয় ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম এবং রেজিস্ট্রার (অতিরিক্ত দায়িত্ব) অধ্যাপক ড. শেখ মোহাম্মদ হুমায়ুন কবির। সংবাদ সম্মেলনে লিখিত বক্তব্য পাঠ করেন ২৪ তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উপলক্ষে গঠিত মিডিয়া কমিটির সভাপতি ও গণিত বিভাগের অধ্যাপক ড. উজ্জ্বল কুমার দেব। কমিটির সদস্যদের মধ্যে আরও উপস্থিত ছিলেন উপ—পরিচালক (জনসংযোগ) জনাব মোহাম্মদ ফজলুর রহমান এবং জনসংযোগ কর্মকতার্ জনাব আইদিত ইবনে মঞ্জু।

সাংবাদিক সম্মেলনে  জানানো হয়, চুয়েটের ২৪তম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় দিবস উপলক্ষে দিনব্যাপী নানা কর্মসূচির আয়োজন করা হচ্ছে। ০১ সেপ্টেম্বর (মঙ্গলবার), ২০২৬ খ্রিঃ সকাল ৯টা ৫৫ মিনিটে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের বিভিন্ন বিভাগ, হল ও শাখা থেকে ব্যানারসহ র‌্যালি নিয়ে বাস্কেটবল প্রাঙ্গণে সমবেত হওয়ার মধ্য দিয়ে কর্মসূচি শুরু হবে। এরপর সকাল ১০টা ১৫ মিনিটে জাতীয় পতাকা ও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পতাকা উত্তোলন এবং জাতীয় সংগীত পরিবেশন করা হবে। সকাল ১০টা ২৫ মিনিটে আলহাজ্ব জসিম উদ্দিন ফাউন্ডেশন থেকে উপহার হিসেবে প্রাপ্ত ৬ টি বাস উদ্বোধন, ১০টা ৩৫ মিনিটে বৃক্ষরোপণ কর্মসূচি এবং ১০টা ৪৫ মিনিটে গোলচত্ত্বর থেকে আনন্দ র‌্যালি অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। সকাল ১১.১০ টায় কেন্দ্রীয় অডিটোরিয়ামে চুয়েটের ওপর প্রামাণ্যচিত্র প্রদর্শন এবং ১১টা ২০ মিনিটে আলোচনা সভা অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। এছাড়া রক্তদান কর্মসূচির আয়োজন, কেন্দ্রীয় খেলার মাঠে কর্মকর্তা বনাম কর্মচারী এবং ছাত্র বনাম শিক্ষকদের মধ্যে প্রীতি ফুটবল ম্যাচ অনুষ্ঠিত হবে এবং খেলা শেষে পুরস্কার বিতরণ করা হবে। সন্ধ্যা ৬টা থেকে রাত ৮টা পর্যন্ত কেন্দ্রীয় অডিটোরিয়ামে সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠানের আয়োজন থাকবে।

এতে আরও জানানো হয়, চুয়েটের গোল চত্বরে চট্টগ্রাম ওয়াসা কর্তৃক প্রদত্ত পানি সংযোগ লাইনের ভিত্তিপ্রস্তর স্থাপন করা হবে। উক্ত ভিত্তিপ্রস্তর উদ্বোধন করবেন গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় অর্থ ও পরিকল্পনামন্ত্রী জনাব আমির খসরু মাহমুদ চৌধুরী এমপি। এরপর গোল চত্বরে স্মারক বৃক্ষরোপণ কর্মসূচি অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। জসিম উদ্দিন ফাউন্ডেশন কর্তৃক চুয়েটকে উপহার হিসেবে প্রদত্ত বাসগুলোর চাবি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে হস্তান্তর করবেন আলহাজ্ব জসিম উদ্দিন ফাউন্ডেশনের সম্মানিত চেয়ারম্যান জনাব মোহাম্মদ জসিম উদ্দিন।

title: Courtesy meeting and exchange of views between CUET VC and Honorable State Minister of Land.
text:
**মাননীয় ভূমি প্রতিমন্ত্রীর সাথে চুয়েট ভিসি'র সৌজন্য সাক্ষাৎ ও মতবিনিময়**

মাননীয় ভূমি এবং পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রাম বিষয়ক প্রতিমন্ত্রী ব্যারিস্টার মীর মোহাম্মদ হেলাল উদ্দীন মহোদয় এর সাথে সৌজন্য সাক্ষাৎ ও মতবিনিময় করেছেন চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (চুয়েট) এর মাননীয় ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম। আজ ২৫ আগস্ট, ২০২৬ খ্রি:, মঙ্গলবার ঢাকায় প্রতিমন্ত্রী মহোদয় এর কার্যালয়ে এই সৌজন্য সাক্ষাৎ ও মতবিনিময় অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।
এ সময় মাননীয় প্রতিমন্ত্রী মহোদয়কে চুয়েট এর সার্বিক বিষয় তুলে ধরেন ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর মহোদয়। একইসাথে তিনি চুয়েট এর উন্নয়নে প্রতিমন্ত্রী মহোদয় এর সহযোগিতা কামনা করেন। প্রতিমন্ত্রী মহোদয় চুয়েট এর অধিকতর উন্নয়ন ও সমৃদ্ধি কামনা করেন এবং সার্বিক সহযোগিতার আশ্বাস প্রদান করেন।

title: “Chasing Light - Architecture, Art, Light & Beyond Boundaries” শীর্ষক সেমিনার
text: চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (CUET)-এরস্থাপত্য বিভাগ ২৪ আগস্ট ২০২৬ তারিখে **“Chasing Light - Architecture, Art, Light & Beyond Boundaries”** শীর্ষক একটি সেমিনারের আয়োজন করে। সেমিনারে স্থাপত্যের আলোক নকশা নিয়ে একটি প্রাণবন্ত ও জ্ঞানসমৃদ্ধ আলোচনায় অংশ নেন স্থপতি নিশান বড়ুয়া এবং স্থপতি ফারাহবী রহমান। স্থপতি নিশান বড়ুয়া চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়েরস্থাপত্য বিভাগের একজন প্রাক্তন শিক্ষার্থী। তিনি বর্তমানে জার্মানভিত্তিকআলোক নকশা প্রতিষ্ঠান Licht Kunst Licht AG-এ কর্মরত আছেন। তিনি Hochschule Wismar, University of Applied Sciences: Technology, Business and Design থেকেস্থাপত্য আলোক নকশায় স্নাতকোত্তর (M.A.) ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেন। অন্যদিকে, ঢাকাভিত্তিক Light Commun, Bangladesh-এর প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও প্রধান নকশাবিদ স্থপতি ফারাহবী রহমান সুইডেনের KTH Royal Institute of Technology থেকে স্থাপত্য আলোক নকশায় স্নাতকোত্তর (M.Sc.) ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন। বর্তমানে তিনি বাংলাদেশের স্থানীয় প্রেক্ষাপটে আলোক নকশা নিয়ে কাজ করছেন। সেমিনারটি আয়োজন করে CUET-এর স্থাপত্য বিভাগের ফ্যাব্রিকেশন ল্যাব। সেমিনারটি অংশগ্রহণকারীদেরআলোক নকশাকে একটি পেশাগত ও একাডেমিক ক্ষেত্র হিসেবে জানার এক আকর্ষণীয় সুযোগ করে দেয়। বক্তারা তুলে ধরেন, কীভাবে আলোক নকশাকে শুধু একটি কারিগরি বিষয় হিসেবে নয়, বরং একটি শিল্পমাধ্যম এবং গবেষণার ক্ষেত্র হিসেবেও বিবেচনা করা যায়। তাঁদের আলোচনার মাধ্যমে স্থাপত্যের সঙ্গে দেশীয় ও আন্তর্জাতিক আলোক নকশা চর্চার একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সংযোগও উঠে আসে। আলোচনাজুড়ে শিক্ষার্থীদের সক্রিয় অংশগ্রহণ ছিল লক্ষণীয়। তারা স্থাপত্যচর্চারপ্রচলিত সীমারেখার বাইরে আলোক নকশার নতুন সম্ভাবনা ও বিভিন্ন দিক সম্পর্কে জানার সুযোগ পায়। বক্তাদের শিক্ষাজীবন ও পেশাগত যাত্রা অনেক শিক্ষার্থীর সামনে স্থাপত্যের ভেতরে ভবিষ্যৎ ক্যারিয়ারের সম্পূর্ণ নতুন কিছু দিক উন্মোচন করে। বিশেষ করে, স্থাপত্যের সঙ্গে আলো, শিল্প, প্রযুক্তি ও গবেষণার সমন্বয় কীভাবে নতুন ধরনের পেশাগত সম্ভাবনা তৈরি করতে পারে, সে সম্পর্কে শিক্ষার্থীরা একটি সুস্পষ্ট ধারণা লাভ করে। তাই **“Chasing Light - Architecture, Art, Light & Beyond Boundaries”**শুধু আলো নিয়ে একটি সেমিনার ছিল না; বরং এটি শিক্ষার্থীদের স্থাপত্যকে একটি ভিন্ন দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে দেখার সুযোগ করে দেয়। একই সঙ্গে এটি তাদের স্থাপত্যের প্রচলিত সীমানার বাইরে চিন্তা করতে এবং ভবিষ্যৎ পেশাগত যাত্রায় স্থাপত্যের মধ্যেই নতুন পথ ও সম্ভাবনা আবিষ্কারের জন্য অনুপ্রাণিত করে। সেমিনারে বিভিন্ন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের শিক্ষার্থী এবং আলোক নকশায় আগ্রহী ব্যক্তিরা অংশগ্রহণ করেন। সেমিনারটির সমন্বয় করেন সহকারী অধ্যাপক নূর মোহাম্মদ খান ও ফ্যাব্রিকেশন ল্যাবের সমন্বয়কারী সহকারী অধ্যাপক অমিত ইমতিয়াজ। অনুষ্ঠানে স্থাপত্য ও পরিকল্পনা অনুষদের সম্মানিত ডিন অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ রাশিদুল হাসান, স্থাপত্য বিভাগের বিভাগীয় প্রধান অধ্যাপক ড. সজল চৌধুরী এবং বিভাগের অন্যান্য শিক্ষকবৃন্দ উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

title: CUET VC congratulates Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on being elected as His Excellency the President.
text:
**                                  হামান্য রাষ্ট্রপতি নির্বাচিত হওয়ায় মির্জা ফখরুল ইসলাম আলমগীরকে চুয়েট ভিসি'র অভিনন্দন**

গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশের মহামান্য রাষ্ট্রপতি নির্বাচিত হওয়ায় জনাব মির্জা ফখরুল ইসলাম আলমগীর-কে আন্তরিক অভিনন্দন ও শুভেচ্ছা জানিয়েছেন চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় (চুয়েট)-এর মাননীয় ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর অধ্যাপক ড. আবু সাদাত মুহাম্মদ সায়েম।

এক অভিনন্দন বার্তায় চুয়েট ভিসি বলেন, "জনাব মির্জা ফখরুল ইসলাম আলমগীর একজন দীর্ঘ রাজনৈতিক অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন ব্যক্তিত্ব। তাঁর প্রজ্ঞাবান ও বিচক্ষণ নেতৃত্ব দেশের অগ্রযাত্রাকে আরও সুদৃঢ় করবে এবং জনগণের আশা-আকাঙ্ক্ষার প্রতিফলন ঘটাবে বলে আমি প্রত্যাশা করি। দেশ ও মানুষের কল্যাণে তাঁর এই নতুন পথচলা সফল হোক-এই কামনা করি। একইসঙ্গে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়গুলোর চ্যান্সেলর হিসেবে তিনি দেশের উচ্চ শিক্ষা ও গবেষণার গুণগত মান বৃদ্ধি এবং আন্তর্জাতিক পরিমন্ডলে বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়গুলোকে আরো মর্যাদাময় স্থানে নিয়ে যাওয়ার ক্ষেত্রে সুযোগ্য অভিভাবক হিসেবে ভূমিকা রাখবেন বলে আমি দৃঢ়ভাবে বিশ্বাস করি।"
section_path: CUET VC congratulates Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on being elected as His Excellency the President.

title: চুয়েটে স্থাপত্য বিভাগে ‘Spatial (IN) Justice’ শীর্ষক সেমিনার অনুষ্ঠিত
text:
চট্টগ্রাম প্রকৌশল ও প্রযুক্তি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের (চুয়েট)-এর স্থাপত্য বিভাগের উদ্যোগে "Spatial (IN) Justice: How Does it Manifest in the Built Environment?" শীর্ষক সেমিনার অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে। আজ ১৮ আগস্ট (মঙ্গলবার) স্থাপত্য বিভাগের জুরী রুমে আয়োজিত সেমিনারে প্রধান অতিথি ছিলেন চুয়েটের স্থাপত্য ও পরিকল্পনা অনুষদের ডীন অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ রাশিদুল হাসান। সেমিনারে প্রধান বক্তা ছিলেন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের দ্য ক্যাথলিক ইউনিভার্সিটি অব আমেরিকা-এর স্কুল অব আর্কিটেকচার অ্যান্ড অ্যালাইড আর্টস-এর অর্ডিনারি প্রফেসর ড. আদনান জিলুর মোর্শেদ। সেমিনারে সভাপতিত্ব করেন স্থাপত্য বিভাগের বিভাগীয় প্রধান অধ্যাপক ড. সজল চৌধুরী। সেমিনার সঞ্চালনা করেন স্থাপত্য বিভাগের সহকারী অধ্যাপক নূর মোহাম্মদ খান।

প্রধান অতিথির বক্তব্যে অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ রাশিদুল হাসান বলেন, “স্থাপত্য কেবল নান্দনিকতা ও কাঠামোগত সৌন্দর্যের বিষয় নয় বরং মানুষের জীবন, অধিকার ও সামাজিক সুযোগের সঙ্গেও এটি গভীরভাবে সম্পর্কিত। একটি মানবিক ও ন্যায়সংগত নির্মিত পরিবেশ নিশ্চিত করা স্থপতিদের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দায়িত্ব।”

সভাপতির বক্তব্যে স্থাপত্য বিভাগের বিভাগীয় প্রধান অধ্যাপক ড. সজল চৌধুরী বলেন, “একজন স্থপতির দায়িত্ব শুধু সুন্দর ভবন তৈরি করা নয় বরং এমন পরিবেশ সৃষ্টি করা, যেখানে সমাজের সকল শ্রেণির মানুষ সমানভাবে সুযোগ ও সুবিধা লাভ করতে পারে। Spatial Justice নিয়ে এ ধরনের আলোচনা শিক্ষার্থীদের স্থাপত্যকে আরও বিস্তৃত সামাজিক ও মানবিক দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে দেখতে সহায়তা করবে।”

উল্লেখ্য, সেমিনারে স্থাপত্য বিভাগের শিক্ষক ও শিক্ষার্থীরা অংশগ্রহণ করেন। আলোচনা শেষে অনুষ্ঠিত প্রশ্নোত্তর পর্বে শিক্ষার্থীরা স্থানিক বৈষম্য, পরিকল্পিত নগরায়ণ, সামাজিক অন্তর্ভুক্তি ও ন্যায়সংগত নির্মিত পরিবেশ নিয়ে বিভিন্ন প্রশ্ন ও মতামত তুলে ধরেন।
